/**
 * The shared prop axes. Every component that takes a variant, a size, a shape
 * or a tone takes THESE — the value is (or maps to) a fractalstyler class, so
 * the same word means the same thing on a button, an input, a card or a tag.
 */

/** Visual style — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Variant =
	| 'primary'
	| 'secondary'
	| 'themed'
	| 'outline'
	| 'ghost'
	| 'link'
	| 'soft'
	| 'info'
	| 'success'
	| 'warning'
	| 'danger';

/** Control scale: height + text size. */
export type Size = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

/** Corner shape — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Shape = 'rect' | 'mincurved' | 'modern' | 'curved' | 'round';

/** Status colour for messages, badges, meters. */
export type Tone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';

/** Where a floating element sits relative to its anchor. */
export type Placement =
	| 'top'
	| 'top-start'
	| 'top-end'
	| 'bottom'
	| 'bottom-start'
	| 'bottom-end'
	| 'left'
	| 'right';

export type Orientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

/** Height + text classes for a control (button, input, select, toggle). */
export const sizeClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'h-md text-xs',
	sm: 'h-bs text-sm',
	md: 'h-lg text-md',
	lg: 'h-xl text-bs',
	xl: 'h-2xl text-lg'
};

/** Height only — for square things (icon buttons, avatars, dots). */
export const heightClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'h-md',
	sm: 'h-bs',
	md: 'h-lg',
	lg: 'h-xl',
	xl: 'h-2xl'
};

/** Text scale only. */
export const textClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'text-xs',
	sm: 'text-sm',
	md: 'text-md',
	lg: 'text-bs',
	xl: 'text-lg'
};

/** Padding for a surface (card, popover, dialog) at each size. */
export const padClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'pad-sm',
	sm: 'pad-md',
	md: 'pad-bs',
	lg: 'pad-lg',
	xl: 'pad-xl'
};

/** `.floating` placement modifier for a Placement. */
export const placementClass: Record<Placement, string> = {
	top: 'at-top',
	'top-start': 'at-top-start',
	'top-end': 'at-top-end',
	bottom: 'at-bottom',
	'bottom-start': 'at-bottom-start',
	'bottom-end': 'at-bottom-end',
	left: 'at-left',
	right: 'at-right'
};

/** Text colour class for a tone. */
export const toneText: Record<Tone, string> = {
	neutral: 'text-secondary',
	info: 'text-info',
	success: 'text-success',
	warning: 'text-warning',
	danger: 'text-danger'
};
import type { Attachment } from 'svelte/attachments';

/** The CSS anchor name for an id — `$props.id()` output is a fine id. */
export function anchorName(id: string): string {
	return `--anchor-${id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')}`;
}

/**
 * Pair a trigger with its floating element. Put `{@attach anchor(id)}` on the
 * trigger (with class `anchor`) and `{@attach floating(id)}` on the floating
 * element (with class `floating at-…`): both receive the same `--anchor`
 * name, and CSS anchor positioning does the rest.
 */
export function anchor(id: string): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		node.style.setProperty('--anchor', anchorName(id));
		return () => node.style.removeProperty('--anchor');
	};
}

/** The floating side of `anchor()`. `offset` overrides the gap (any CSS length or token). */
export function floating(id: string, offset?: string): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		node.style.setProperty('--anchor', anchorName(id));
		if (offset) node.style.setProperty('--offset', offset);
		return () => {
			node.style.removeProperty('--anchor');
			node.style.removeProperty('--offset');
		};
	};
}

/**
 * Keep a boolean in step with a native popover element.
 * Returns an attachment for the `[popover]` element: it shows/hides the
 * popover when `isOpen()` changes and reports user dismissal through `onChange`.
 */
export function popoverSync(
	isOpen: () => boolean,
	onChange: (open: boolean) => void
): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		const want = isOpen();
		const shown = node.matches(':popover-open');
		if (want && !shown) node.showPopover();
		else if (!want && shown) node.hidePopover();

		const onToggle = (event: Event) => {
			const next = (event as ToggleEvent).newState === 'open';
			if (next !== isOpen()) onChange(next);
		};
		node.addEventListener('toggle', onToggle);
		return () => node.removeEventListener('toggle', onToggle);
	};
}

/**
 * The same for a native `<dialog>`: opens modally when `isOpen()` turns true,
 * closes when it turns false, and reports Esc / backdrop dismissal.
 */
export function dialogSync(
	isOpen: () => boolean,
	onChange: (open: boolean) => void,
	options: { modal?: boolean; dismissible?: boolean } = {}
): Attachment<HTMLDialogElement> {
	return (node) => {
		const { modal = true, dismissible = true } = options;
		const want = isOpen();
		if (want && !node.open) {
			if (modal) node.showModal();
			else node.show();
		} else if (!want && node.open) node.close();

		const onClose = () => {
			if (isOpen()) onChange(false);
		};
		const onCancel = (event: Event) => {
			if (!dismissible) event.preventDefault();
		};
		// A click that lands on the dialog element itself is a click on the backdrop.
		const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
			if (dismissible && event.target === node) node.close();
		};
		node.addEventListener('close', onClose);
		node.addEventListener('cancel', onCancel);
		node.addEventListener('click', onClick);
		return () => {
			node.removeEventListener('close', onClose);
			node.removeEventListener('cancel', onCancel);
			node.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
		};
	};
}

/**
 * Motion attachments — `{@attach …}` factories for gestures, scroll and layout.
 *
 * Every attachment writes ONLY CSS custom properties (plus, for `inView`, a
 * state class); the stylesheet's `.motion` / `.tilt` classes turn them into
 * real transforms. Every attachment cleans up on teardown and honours reduced
 * motion (`prefers-reduced-motion` or `globalMotion.scale === 0`).
 */
import { tick } from 'svelte';
import type { Attachment } from 'svelte/attachments';
import { animate, getMotion, getVelocity, setMotion } from './animate.js';
import { reducedMotion } from './global.svelte.js';
import type { SpringInput } from './spring.js';

// ───────────────────────────── internals ─────────────────────────────

type MotionNode = HTMLElement | SVGElement;

function fmt(n: number): string {
	const r = Math.round(n * 10000) / 10000;
	return String(Object.is(r, -0) ? 0 : r);
}

function clamp(n: number, lo: number, hi: number): number {
	return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, n));
}

const passive: AddEventListenerOptions = { passive: true };

/** A job in the shared scroll frame: every `read` runs before any `write`. */
interface FrameJob {
	read(): void;
	write(): void;
}

const scrollJobs = new Set<FrameJob>();
let scrollFrame = 0;

function runScrollFrame(): void {
	scrollFrame = 0;
	const jobs = Array.from(scrollJobs);
	for (const job of jobs) job.read();
	for (const job of jobs) job.write();
}

function requestScrollFrame(): void {
	if (scrollFrame === 0) scrollFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runScrollFrame);
}

/** Register a scroll-linked job; shares one passive scroll/resize listener and one rAF across all jobs. */
function addScrollJob(job: FrameJob): () => void {
	if (scrollJobs.size === 0) {
		window.addEventListener('scroll', requestScrollFrame, passive);
		window.addEventListener('resize', requestScrollFrame, passive);
	}
	scrollJobs.add(job);
	requestScrollFrame();

/** The documentation manifest of one component folder. See AGENTS.md, Law 2. */
export interface ComponentDoc {
	/** The primary export, PascalCase — `Button`. */
	name: string;
	/** One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header. */
	summary: string;
	/** One to three paragraphs. A blank line starts a new paragraph; `code` is allowed. */
	description: string;
	/** Every non-primary component export → one line on what it is for. */
	parts?: Record<string, string>;
	/** Short capability bullets. */
	features?: string[];
	/** How the component is accessible — at least one statement. */
	accessibility: string[];
	/** Keyboard interactions, when the component is interactive. */
	keyboard?: { keys: string; action: string }[];
	/** Non-component exports: functions, attachments, classes, stores. */
	api?: { name: string; type: string; description: string }[];
	/** Slugs of related components. */
	related?: string[];
	status?: 'stable' | 'beta';
}

export function defineDoc(doc: ComponentDoc): ComponentDoc {
	return doc;
}

/**
 * Svelte transition functions driven by real spring curves.
 *
 * Each returns `{ delay, duration, easing, css }` where `duration` is the
 * spring's settle time (`springDuration`) and `easing` follows the spring
 * itself (`springEase`) — so `bouncy` really overshoots. Svelte runs the `css`
 * keyframes via the Web Animations API. Under reduced motion every transition
 * becomes a short plain opacity fade.
 */
import type { TransitionConfig } from 'svelte/transition';
import { reducedMotion } from './global.svelte.js';
import { springDuration, springEase, type SpringInput } from './spring.js';

/** Parameters shared by every spring transition. */
export interface SpringTransitionParams {
	/** The spring (preset name or partial config). Defaults to `'snappy'`. */
	spring?: SpringInput;
	/** Delay before the transition starts, in ms. Defaults to `0`. */
	delay?: number;
}

const REDUCED_MS = 120;

function reduced(delay: number): TransitionConfig {
	return { delay, duration: REDUCED_MS, css: (t) => `opacity: ${t.toFixed(3)}` };
}

function base(params: SpringTransitionParams): { delay: number; duration: number; easing: (t: number) => number } {
	const spring = params.spring ?? 'snappy';
	return { delay: params.delay ?? 0, duration: springDuration(spring), easing: springEase(spring) };
}

function computed(node: Element): { opacity: number; transform: string } {
	const style = getComputedStyle(node);
	const opacity = Number.parseFloat(style.opacity);
	return {
		opacity: Number.isFinite(opacity) ? opacity : 1,
		transform: style.transform === 'none' ? '' : style.transform

}

const n = (v: number): string => (Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000).toString();

/**
 * Fade in/out along a spring curve.
 * @param node The transitioning element.
 * @param params `spring`, `delay`.

export function springFade(node: Element, params: SpringTransitionParams = {}): TransitionConfig {
	if (reducedMotion.current) return reduced(params.delay ?? 0);
	const { opacity } = computed(node);
	return { ...base(params), css: (t) => `opacity: ${n(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t)) * opacity)}` };
}

## 1. The two laws

### Law 1 — fractalstyler only

Styling is **composition of registered classes in markup**. Nothing else.

  are short).
- Modifiers are never standalone: `.row.xcenter`, never a bare `.xcenter`.
- There is no `.w-*`, `.pad-x-*`, `.border-top`. Search the registry; never guess.

**Dynamic values travel through custom properties.** JavaScript may write

`vars()` attachment (`src/lib/motion`) to bind values:
`<div class="fill" {@attach vars({ value: 0.4 })}>`. Never assign
`node.style.transform = …` or any real property.

**The extension layer is small on purpose.** Compose first. If the system
genuinely cannot express something, add the *smallest general primitive* to
your kit's fragment `src/lib/styles/layers/kits/<kit>.css`:

- plain CSS, tokens only (`var(--space-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, colour roles),
  `rem`/`em`/`%` — no px above 2, no hex, no `&` nesting;
- named in the system's voice (`.track`, `.thumb`, `.indicator`) — a
  primitive several components could use, not `.my-component-inner`;
- hard budget: **90 lines per kit fragment**. The gate fails above it;
- only edit your own kit's fragment. Never edit `custom.css` (generated) or
  another layer file. After editing run `pnpm gen`.

# DESIGN

The design language of maxima-ui. It is fractalstyler's language, held to a
premium bar — restrained, precise, quiet until touched.

## Principles

1. **Composition over invention.** A component is a sentence written in
   fractalstyler's vocabulary. If two components look related, it is because
   they share classes, not because someone matched them by eye.
2. **Hierarchy through ink, not size.** `text-primary` → `text-secondary` →
   `text-muted` carry most hierarchy. Size and weight change rarely.
3. **Hairlines and light.** Surfaces are separated by 1px borders
   (`border`, `border-subtle`) and lifted by the elevation ladder (`shad-*`)
   with a lit top edge (`rim`). Floating surfaces are `glass`.
4. **Motion is physics.** Anything a person moves or triggers is driven by a
   spring — the same solver produces the CSS `linear()` tokens
   (`--spring-snappy` …) and drives the JavaScript engine, so a CSS transition
   and a dragged element settle the same way. Motion is interruptible, never
   blocks input, and collapses to nothing under reduced motion.
5. **One theme, three numbers.** `--hue`, `--chroma`, `--tint` generate every
   colour role in both modes. Shape (`data-radius`), density (`data-density`)
   and motion (`data-motion`) are independent axes that rewrite ladders, not
   components.

## The shared axes

| Axis | Values | Mechanism |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `variant` | primary · secondary · themed · soft · outline · ghost · link · info · success · warning · danger | a class of the same name |
| `size` | xs · sm · md · lg · xl | `sizeClass[size]` → height + text ladder |
| `shape` | rect · mincurved · modern · curved · round | a class of the same name |
| `tone` | neutral · info · success · warning · danger | status colour roles |

## The extension layer

| Layer | Adds |
|:---|:---|
| `00-tokens` | motion channels (`@property`), spring/motion scale, measure ladder |
| `01-springs` | generated `--spring-*` `linear()` easings |
| `10-motion` | `.motion` `.tilt` `.spring` `.pop` `.enter-*` `.anim-*` `.reveal`, view transitions |
| `20-surface` | `.glass` `.rim` `.glow` `.soft` `.measure-*` and small layout primitives |
| `30-overlay` | `.anchor` `.floating` `.dialog` `.sheet` `.layer` |
| `40-controls` | `.bare` `.item` `.track` `.fill` `.thumb` `.ring` `.indicator` `.caret` |
| `60-themes` | the parametric theme and the radius / density / motion axes |
| `kits/*` | ≤ 90 lines per kit, for primitives composition cannot express |

137		import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';

141			/** The visual style of the button. */
142			variant?: Variant;
143			/** The control height and text scale. */
144			size?: Size;
145			/** The content. */
146			children?: Snippet;
147		}

149		let { variant = 'primary', size = 'md', class: klass, children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
150	</script>

153		{@render children?.()}

160	- `class` is always accepted and merged last via the array form

162	  and extend the matching `svelte/elements` attribute type.
163	- Two-way state is `$bindable()` **and** has a callback
164	  (`value = $bindable()`, `onValueChange`). Works controlled and uncontrolled.

167	  warning danger`), `Size` (`xs sm md lg xl` → `sizeClass[size]`), `Shape`

169	  warning danger`), `Placement`.

183	  state-driven motion; the JS spring engine (`animate`, `SpringValue`, the

239	drag({ axis, bounds, snapBack, momentum, onDragEnd })
240	parallax() scrollProgress()
241	createFlip() → { attach, read(), play(), run(fn) }   // FLIP layout springs; items carry data-flip-id
242	
243	// Svelte transitions with spring easing — transition:springScale={{ spring: 'bouncy' }}
244	springFade springFly springScale springBlur springSlide
245	
246	// view transitions
247	startViewTransition(update, { type: 'fade'|'slide'|'slide-back'|'scale'|'reveal'|'none', origin })
248	setupViewTransitions(onNavigate, { type })    vtName('hero')   // element also needs class "vt-name"
249	
250	// theme
251	theme (ThemeState: mode theme hue chroma tint radius density motion resolvedMode; setTheme() setMode() toggleMode(event) reset())
252	themes, initTheme(), themeInitScript()
253	```
254	
255	CSS side (see `src/lib/styles/layers/10-motion.css`): `.spring` + `.spring-<preset>`
256	for state transitions, `.pop` + `.enter-*` for anything that opens (works on
257	`[popover]`, `<dialog open>`, and `.open`), `.anim-in` (staggered by `--i`),
258	`.reveal`/`.in`, `.lift`, `.press`.
259
```

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAnchorAttributes, HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import type { IconData } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import { luLoaderCircle } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide';
	import { press } from '../../../motion/index.js';
	import { sizeClass, type Shape, type Size, type Variant } from '../../../internal/tokens.js';

	interface Props extends HTMLButtonAttributes {
		/** The visual style. `primary` is the page's main action; use one per view. */
		variant?: Variant;
		/** The control height and text scale. */
		size?: Size;
		/** The corner shape. */
		shape?: Shape;
		/** An icon drawn before the label. */
		icon?: IconData;
		/** An icon drawn after the label. */
		iconEnd?: IconData;
		/** Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon and blocks interaction, keeping the button's width. */
		loading?: boolean;
		/** Stretches the button to the full width of its container. */
		block?: boolean;
		/** Renders an `<a>` that looks like a button. Use for navigation. */
		href?: string;
		/** Where to open the link, when `href` is set. */
		target?: HTMLAnchorAttributes['target'];
		/** Springs the button down under the pointer. Turn off for a still button. */
		pressable?: boolean;
		/** The label. */
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		variant = 'primary',
		size = 'md',
		shape = 'modern',
		icon,
		iconEnd,
		loading = false,
		block = false,
		href,
		target,
		pressable = true,
		disabled,
		type = 'button',
		class: klass,
		children,
		...rest
	}: Props = $props();

	const classes = $derived([
		'button no-scaling gap-sm weight-500',
		variant,
		sizeClass[size],
		shape,
		block ? 'wfull' : 'inline-flex',
		pressable && 'motion',
		klass
	]);
	const spring = $derived(pressable ? press() : undefined);
</script>

{#snippet content()}
	{#if loading}
		<Icon icon={luLoaderCircle} class="anim-spin" />
	{:else if icon}
		<Icon {icon} />
	{/if}
	{@render children?.()}
	{#if iconEnd}
		<Icon icon={iconEnd} />
	{/if}
{/snippet}

{#if href && !disabled}
	<a
		class={classes}
		{href}
		{target}
		rel={target === '_blank' ? 'noopener noreferrer' : undefined}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest as HTMLAnchorAttributes}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</a>
{:else}
	<button
		class={classes}
		{type}
		disabled={disabled || loading}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</button>
{/if}

/**
 * The shared prop axes. Every component that takes a variant, a size, a shape
 * or a tone takes THESE — the value is (or maps to) a fractalstyler class, so
 * the same word means the same thing on a button, an input, a card or a tag.
 */

/** Visual style — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Variant =
	| 'primary'
	| 'secondary'

	| 'outline'
	| 'ghost'
	| 'link'
	| 'soft'
	| 'info'

/** Control scale: height + text size. */
export type Size = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

/** Corner shape — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Shape = 'rect' | 'mincurved' | 'modern' | 'curved' | 'round';

/** Status colour for messages, badges, meters. */
export type Tone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';

/** Where a floating element sits relative to its anchor. */
export type Placement =
	| 'top'

	| 'bottom-start'
	| 'bottom-end'
	| 'left'
	| 'right';

export type Orientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

/* maxima-ui — the extension layer for fractalstyler.
 * Loaded after '@fractaldesign/fractalstyler/styles'. Tokens only: every value
 * below rides a fractalstyler token or one declared here. */

/* The motion channels. Registered and non-inheriting, so a moving parent never
 * leaks its offset into a moving child. JavaScript writes these; .motion reads them. */
@property --mx { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0; }
@property --my { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0; }
@property --ms { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 1; }
@property --mr { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0; }
@property --mo { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 1; }
@property --rx { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0; }
@property --ry { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0; }

:root {
	/* the current spring — .spring-* classes and [data-motion] re-point it */
	--spring: var(--spring-snappy);
	--spring-ms: var(--spring-snappy-ms);
	/* 1 = full motion, 0 = none. Every duration in this layer multiplies by it. */
	--motion-scale: 1;
	--stagger: 60ms;

	/* value channels (inheriting): a control sets them, its parts read them */
	--value: 0;
	--from: 0;
	--i: 0;
	--px: 50;
	--py: 50;
	--ix: 0;
	--iy: 0;
	--iw: 0;
	--ih: 0;

	/* floating */
	--anchor: --none;
	--offset: var(--space-sm);
	--scrim: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55);
	--glass-blur: 1rem;
	--glass-alpha: 72%;

	/* view transitions */
	--vt-name: none;
	--vt-x: 0;
	--vt-y: 0;

	/* the measure ladder — widths for panels, dialogs, popovers */
	--measure-xs: 14rem;
	--measure-sm: 20rem;
	--measure-md: 28rem;
	--measure-lg: 36rem;
	--measure-xl: 48rem;
	--measure-2xl: 64rem;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	:root { --motion-scale: 0; }
}

/** The documentation manifest of one component folder. See AGENTS.md, Law 2. */
export interface ComponentDoc {
	/** The primary export, PascalCase — `Button`. */
	name: string;
	/** One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header. */
	summary: string;
	/** One to three paragraphs. A blank line starts a new paragraph; `code` is allowed. */
	description: string;
	/** Every non-primary component export → one line on what it is for. */
	parts?: Record<string, string>;
	/** Short capability bullets. */
	features?: string[];
	/** How the component is accessible — at least one statement. */
	accessibility: string[];
	/** Keyboard interactions, when the component is interactive. */
	keyboard?: { keys: string; action: string }[];
	/** Non-component exports: functions, attachments, classes, stores. */
	api?: { name: string; type: string; description: string }[];
	/** Slugs of related components. */
	related?: string[];
	status?: 'stable' | 'beta';
}

export function defineDoc(doc: ComponentDoc): ComponentDoc {
	return doc;
}

// The gate's rules. Each check returns diagnostics; nothing here throws on bad input.

import ts from 'typescript';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { ComponentAnalysis, KitInfo } from './analysis.ts';
import { parseTs } from './api.ts';
import type { LayerBuild } from './css.ts';
import { extractScripts, markupOf, matchJsBrace, skipQuoted, stringLiterals } from './svelte.ts';
import { PATHS, closest, cssCodeLines, escapeRe, lineAt, listDir, readText, rel, walkFiles } from './util.ts';

export interface Diag {
	rule: string;
	severity: 'error' | 'warning';
	file: string;
	line: number | null;
	message: string;
	fix: string;
}

export const KIT_BUDGET = 90;

// ── the class allowlist ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Allowlist {
	classes: Set<string>;
	stems: string[];
	registryFound: boolean;
}

export function loadAllowlist(layers: LayerBuild): Allowlist {
	const classes = new Set<string>();
	const stems: string[] = [];
	const raw = readText(PATHS.fsRegistry);
	let registryFound = false;
	if (raw) {
		try {
			const rows = JSON.parse(raw) as { class?: string }[];
			registryFound = Array.isArray(rows);
			for (const row of Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []) {
				const name = (row.class ?? '').replace(/^\./, '').trim();
				if (!name) continue;
				if (name.includes('*')) stems.push(name.replace(/\*.*$/, ''));
				else classes.add(name);
			}
		} catch {
			registryFound = false;
		}
	}
	for (const c of layers.harvested) classes.add(c);
	return { classes, stems, registryFound };
}

export function isAllowed(cls: string, allow: Allowlist): boolean {
	return allow.classes.has(cls) || allow.stems.some((s) => cls.startsWith(s)) || /-(mob|desk)$/.test(cls);
}

function unknownClass(cls: string, file: string, line: number, allow: Allowlist): Diag {
	const near = closest(cls, allow.classes, 3);
	return {
		rule: 'class/unknown',
		severity: 'error',
		file,
		line,
		message: `class "${cls}" is not in the fractalstyler registry or the maxima extension layer`,
		fix: near.length
			? `did you mean ${near.map((n) => `"${n}"`).join(', ')}? (registry.md / src/lib/styles/layers)`
			: 'compose from registry.md, or add the smallest general primitive to your kit fragment'
	};
}

// ── class tokens in markup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

const CLASSY = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/;
const COMPARE_BEFORE = /(===|!==|==|!=|\bin|\bcase)\s*$/;
const COMPARE_AFTER = /^\s*(===|!==|==|!=|in\b)/;

/** Class-looking tokens of the string literals inside a JS expression (comparison operands skipped). */
function expressionClassTokens(expr: string): { token: string; offset: number }[] {
	const out: { token: string; offset: number }[] = [];
	for (const lit of stringLiterals(expr)) {
		if (lit.interpolated) continue;
		// comparison operands (`x === 'vertical'`), `case 'x':` labels and `'x' in o` are not class lists
		if (COMPARE_BEFORE.test(expr.slice(0, lit.start)) || COMPARE_AFTER.test(expr.slice(lit.end))) continue;
		let pos = 0;
		for (const tok of lit.value.split(/(\s+)/)) {
			if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok) && CLASSY.test(tok)) out.push({ token: tok, offset: lit.start + 1 + pos });
			pos += tok.length;
		}
	}
	return out;
}

interface ScriptVar {
	init: string;
	offset: number;
}

/** `const x = …` / `let x = …` initialisers of the instance script, by name. */
function scriptVars(src: string): Map<string, ScriptVar> {
	const out = new Map<string, ScriptVar>();
	for (const s of extractScripts(src)) {
		const sf = parseTs(s.content, 'vars.ts');
		const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
			if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(n) && ts.isIdentifier(n.name) && n.initializer) {
				const start = n.initializer.getStart(sf);
				out.set(n.name.text, { init: n.initializer.getText(sf), offset: s.offset + start });
			}
			ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
		};
		visit(sf);
	}
	return out;
}

export function checkSvelteClasses(file: string, src: string, allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const markup = markupOf(src);
	const vars = scriptVars(src);
	const relFile = rel(file);
	const checked = new Set<string>();
	const check = (cls: string, offset: number) => {
		if (!isAllowed(cls, allow)) out.push(unknownClass(cls, relFile, lineAt(src, offset), allow));
	};
	const checkExpr = (expr: string, base: number) => {
		for (const t of expressionClassTokens(expr)) check(t.token, base + t.offset);
		// identifiers that name script variables: check their initialisers too
		for (const m of expr.matchAll(/(?<![\w$.'"`-])([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(?![\w$])/g)) {
			const v = vars.get(m[1]);
			if (!v || checked.has(m[1])) continue;
			checked.add(m[1]);
			for (const t of expressionClassTokens(v.init)) check(t.token, v.offset + t.offset);
		}
	};

	const ATTR = /(?<=[\s])class\s*=\s*/g;
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(ATTR)) {
		const at = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
		const q = markup[at];
		if (q === '"' || q === "'") {
			let i = at + 1;
			let staticText = '';
			while (i < markup.length && markup[i] !== q) {
				if (markup[i] === '{') {
					const close = matchJsBrace(markup, i);
					if (close < 0) break;
					checkExpr(markup.slice(i + 1, close), i + 1);
					staticText += ' '.repeat(close - i + 1);
					i = close + 1;
					continue;
				}
				staticText += markup[i];
				i++;
			}
			let pos = 0;
			for (const tok of staticText.split(/(\s+)/)) {
				if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok)) check(tok, at + 1 + pos);
				pos += tok.length;
			}
		} else if (q === '{') {
			const close = matchJsBrace(markup, at);
			if (close > at) checkExpr(markup.slice(at + 1, close), at + 1);
		}
	}
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(/(?<=[\s])class:([\w-]+)/g)) check(m[1], m.index ?? 0);
	return out;
}

/** String literals of the exported `Record<…, string>` maps in tokens.ts. */
export function checkTokenMaps(allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const src = readText(PATHS.tokensTs);
	if (!src) return [];
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(src, 'tokens.ts');
	for (const st of sf.statements) {
		if (!ts.isVariableStatement(st) || !st.modifiers?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword)) continue;
		for (const d of st.declarationList.declarations) {
			if (!d.type || !/^Record</.test(d.type.getText(sf)) || !d.initializer || !ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(d.initializer)) continue;
			for (const p of d.initializer.properties) {
				if (!ts.isPropertyAssignment(p) || !ts.isStringLiteral(p.initializer)) continue;
				for (const tok of p.initializer.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) {
					if (!isAllowed(tok, allow)) {
						out.push(unknownClass(tok, rel(PATHS.tokensTs), sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(p.getStart(sf)).line + 1, allow));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out;
}

// ── Law 1: no styles, no svg, JS writes only custom properties ──────────────

function startsWithDashes(arg: ts.Expression | undefined): boolean {
	if (!arg) return false;
	if (ts.isStringLiteral(arg) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(arg)) return arg.text.startsWith('--');
	if (ts.isTemplateExpression(arg)) return arg.head.text.startsWith('--');
	return false;
}

function isStyleAccess(n: ts.Expression): boolean {
	return (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n) && n.name.text === 'style') || (ts.isElementAccessExpression(n) && ts.isStringLiteral(n.argumentExpression) && n.argumentExpression.text === 'style');
}

/** AST checks on one script / TS module. */
export function checkScriptAst(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, inMotion: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(code, path.basename(file) + '.ts');
	const line = (n: ts.Node) => lineBase + sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart(sf)).line;
	const push = (n: ts.Node, message: string, fix: string) =>
		out.push({ rule: 'style/js-write', severity: 'error', file, line: line(n), message, fix });
	const CP_FIX = "write a custom property — node.style.setProperty('--x', v) or the vars() attachment — and let a class own the real property";

	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isBinaryExpression(n) && n.operatorToken.kind >= ts.SyntaxKind.FirstAssignment && n.operatorToken.kind <= ts.SyntaxKind.LastAssignment) {
			const left = n.left;
			if (isStyleAccess(left)) push(n, 'assigns element.style directly', CP_FIX);
			else if ((ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) || ts.isElementAccessExpression(left)) && isStyleAccess(left.expression)) {
				const prop = ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) ? left.name.text : left.argumentExpression.getText(sf);
				push(n, prop === 'cssText' ? 'writes .style.cssText' : `assigns .style.${prop.replace(/['"]/g, '')}`, CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression)) {
			const method = n.expression.name.text;
			const target = n.expression.expression;
			if (method === 'setProperty' && isStyleAccess(target) && !startsWithDashes(n.arguments[0]) && !inMotion) {
				const lit = n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0]));
				push(
					n,
					lit ? `style.setProperty(${n.arguments[0].getText(sf)}) sets a real property` : 'style.setProperty() with a non-literal name (only src/lib/motion and src/lib/theme may)',
					"name a custom property literally: setProperty('--x', …)"
				);
			}
			if (method === 'setAttribute' && n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0])) && n.arguments[0].text.toLowerCase() === 'style') {
				push(n, "setAttribute('style', …)", CP_FIX);
			}
			if (method === 'assign' && target.getText(sf) === 'Object' && n.arguments[0] && isStyleAccess(n.arguments[0])) {
				push(n, 'Object.assign(element.style, …)', CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

// ── imports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const LIB_BARE = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?)$/;
const EXAMPLE_ALLOWED = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/maxima-ui(\/motion|\/theme)?)$/;

export function moduleSpecifiers(code: string): { spec: string; line: number }[] {
	const sf = parseTs(code, 'imports.ts');
	const out: { spec: string; line: number }[] = [];
	const add = (lit: ts.Expression | undefined) => {
		if (lit && ts.isStringLiteral(lit)) out.push({ spec: lit.text, line: sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(lit.getStart(sf)).line });
	};
	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isImportDeclaration(n) || ts.isExportDeclaration(n)) add(n.moduleSpecifier);
		else if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && n.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword) add(n.arguments[0]);
		else if (ts.isImportTypeNode(n) && ts.isLiteralTypeNode(n.argument)) add(n.argument.literal);
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

export function checkImports(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, isExample: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	for (const { spec, line } of moduleSpecifiers(code)) {
		let bad = false;
		let fix = '';
		if (isExample) {
			if (!EXAMPLE_ALLOWED.test(spec)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = "examples import exactly what a consumer writes: '@fractaldesign/maxima-ui' (/motion, /theme), '@fractaldesign/icons*', 'svelte*'";
			}
		} else if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
			const target = path.resolve(path.dirname(path.join(PATHS.root, file)), spec);
			if (!target.startsWith(PATHS.lib + path.sep)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = 'relative imports must stay inside src/lib';
			}
		} else if (!LIB_BARE.test(spec)) {
			bad = true;
			fix = "inside src/lib import relatively (no $lib, no #lib); only 'svelte*' and '@fractaldesign/icons*' are bare";
		}
		if (bad) out.push({ rule: 'import/forbidden', severity: 'error', file, line: lineBase + line, message: `import '${spec}'`, fix });
	}
	return out;
}

// ── a component folder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface GateContext {
	allow: Allowlist;
	kits: KitInfo[];
	slugs: Set<string>;
	/** export name → component ids exporting it. */
	exportOwners: Map<string, string[]>;
}

const DOC_KEYS = new Set(['name', 'summary', 'description', 'parts', 'features', 'accessibility', 'keyboard', 'api', 'related', 'status']);
const EXEMPT = new Set(['class', 'children', 'ref']);

function isNonEmptyString(v: unknown): v is string {
	return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
}

export function checkComponent(a: ComponentAnalysis, ctx: GateContext): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const dir = a.ref.relDir;
	const f = (name: string) => `${dir}/${name}`;
	const err = (rule: string, file: string, line: number | null, message: string, fix: string) =>
		out.push({ rule, severity: 'error', file, line, message, fix });
	const warn = (rule: string, file: string, line: number | null, message: string, fix: string) =>
		out.push({ rule, severity: 'warning', file, line, message, fix });

	if (a.crash) {
		err('analysis/crash', dir, null, a.crash.split('\n')[0], 'fix the syntax error in this folder');
		return out;
	}
	if (!ctx.kits.some((k) => k.id === a.ref.kit))
		err('kit/unknown', dir, null, `kit "${a.ref.kit}" is not listed in src/lib/components/kits.ts`, `use one of: ${ctx.kits.map((k) => k.id).join(', ')}`);
	if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(a.ref.slug))
		err('folder/name', dir, null, `folder "${a.ref.slug}" is not kebab-case`, 'rename the folder (e.g. icon-button)');

	// ── structure
	if (!a.hasPrimary) err('folder/primary', f(a.primaryFile), null, `missing the primary component ${a.primaryFile}`, `create ${a.primaryFile} (PascalCase of the folder name)`);
	if (!a.hasIndex) err('folder/index', f('index.ts'), null, 'missing index.ts', `export { default as ${a.name} } from './${a.primaryFile}';`);
	if (!a.hasDoc) err('doc/missing', f('doc.ts'), null, 'missing doc.ts', "export default defineDoc({ … }) — see AGENTS.md 'doc.ts'");
	if (a.examples.length === 0) err('examples/missing', f('examples/'), null, 'no examples', 'add examples/01-usage.svelte (the minimal usage)');
	else if (!a.examples.some((e) => e.file.startsWith('01'))) err('examples/first', f('examples/01-usage.svelte'), null, 'example 01 is missing', 'name the minimal usage examples/01-usage.svelte');
	for (const e of a.examples) {
		if (!e.headerOk)
			err('examples/header', f(`examples/${e.file}`), 1, 'first line is not an example header', 'start with <!-- @example Title :: One sentence describing what it shows. -->');
	}

	// ── index.ts (rule 1)
	if (a.indexError) err('index/parse', f('index.ts'), null, a.indexError, 'fix index.ts');
	if (a.hasIndex) {
		const svelteExports = a.exports.filter((e) => e.svelteFile).map((e) => (e.svelteFile ?? '').replace(/^\.\//, ''));
		if (a.hasPrimary && !a.exports.some((e) => e.name === a.name && e.svelteFile?.replace(/^\.\//, '') === a.primaryFile))
			err('index/export', f('index.ts'), null, `index.ts does not export ${a.name}`, `export { default as ${a.name} } from './${a.primaryFile}';`);
		for (const s of a.svelteFiles) {
			if (s !== a.primaryFile && !svelteExports.includes(s))
				err('index/export', f('index.ts'), null, `part ${s} is not exported`, `export { default as ${s.replace(/\.svelte$/, '')} } from './${s}';`);
		}
		for (const e of a.exports) {
			const owners = ctx.exportOwners.get(e.name) ?? [];
			if (owners.length > 1)
				err('index/duplicate', f('index.ts'), e.line, `export "${e.name}" is also exported by ${owners.filter((o) => o !== `${a.ref.kit}/${a.ref.slug}`).join(', ')}`, 'export names are global (one barrel) — rename one');
		}
	}

	// ── Props + JSDoc (rule 2)
	for (const p of a.parts) {
		for (const prob of p.problems) err('props/missing', f(p.file), 1, prob, 'add <script lang="ts"> with interface Props');
		if (!p.hasProps && p.problems.length === 0) {
			err('props/missing', f(p.file), 1, `${p.name} declares no interface Props`, 'declare interface Props in the instance script, every member with a JSDoc comment');
			continue;
		}
		for (const prop of p.props) {
			if (!prop.description)
				err('props/undocumented', f(p.file), prop.line, `prop "${prop.name}" has no JSDoc description`, `/** One sentence: what ${prop.name} does. */`);
		}
	}

	// ── doc.ts (rule 3)
	if (a.doc) {
		const docFile = f('doc.ts');
		if (a.doc.error || !a.doc.value) {
			err('doc/static', docFile, a.doc.line, a.doc.error ?? 'unreadable', 'pass a plain object literal (strings, arrays, objects) to defineDoc');
		} else {
			const d = a.doc.value;
			const line = a.doc.line;
			for (const k of Object.keys(d)) if (!DOC_KEYS.has(k)) err('doc/unknown-key', docFile, line, `unknown key "${k}"`, `keys: ${[...DOC_KEYS].join(', ')}`);
			if (d.name !== a.name) err('doc/name', docFile, line, `name is ${JSON.stringify(d.name ?? null)}, expected "${a.name}"`, `name: '${a.name}'`);
			if (!isNonEmptyString(d.summary)) err('doc/summary', docFile, line, 'summary is missing', 'one sentence, ending with a period');
			else {
				if (d.summary.length > 160) err('doc/summary', docFile, line, `summary is ${d.summary.length} chars (max 160)`, 'shorten it to one sentence');
				if (!d.summary.trim().endsWith('.')) err('doc/summary', docFile, line, 'summary does not end with a period', 'end the sentence with "."');
			}
			if (!isNonEmptyString(d.description) || d.description.trim().length < 80)
				err('doc/description', docFile, line, `description is ${typeof d.description === 'string' ? d.description.trim().length : 0} chars (min 80)`, 'one to three paragraphs on what it is and when to use it');
			if (!Array.isArray(d.accessibility) || d.accessibility.length === 0 || !d.accessibility.every(isNonEmptyString))
				err('doc/accessibility', docFile, line, 'accessibility needs at least one non-empty statement', "accessibility: ['Renders a native <button> …']");

			const partNames = a.parts.filter((p) => p.name !== a.name).map((p) => p.name).sort();
			const docParts = d.parts && typeof d.parts === 'object' && !Array.isArray(d.parts) ? d.parts : {};
			if (d.parts !== undefined && (typeof d.parts !== 'object' || Array.isArray(d.parts) || d.parts === null))
				err('doc/parts', docFile, line, 'parts must be an object { PartName: "what it is for" }', 'parts: { DialogTitle: "…" }');
			const keys = Object.keys(docParts).sort();
			for (const n of partNames) if (!keys.includes(n)) err('doc/parts', docFile, line, `part ${n} is not described in parts`, `parts: { ${n}: 'One line: what this part is for.' }`);
			for (const k of keys) {
				if (!partNames.includes(k)) err('doc/parts', docFile, line, `parts.${k} is not an exported .svelte part`, 'remove it, or export the part from index.ts');
				else if (!isNonEmptyString((docParts as Record<string, unknown>)[k])) err('doc/parts', docFile, line, `parts.${k} is empty`, 'one line on what the part is for');
			}

			if (d.features !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(d.features) || !d.features.every(isNonEmptyString)))
				err('doc/empty', docFile, line, 'features must be non-empty strings', "features: ['Spring-pressed', …]");
			if (d.keyboard !== undefined) {
				const ok = Array.isArray(d.keyboard) && d.keyboard.every((k) => k !== null && typeof k === 'object' && !Array.isArray(k) && isNonEmptyString(k.keys) && isNonEmptyString(k.action));
				if (!ok) err('doc/keyboard', docFile, line, 'keyboard entries need non-empty keys and action', "keyboard: [{ keys: 'Enter', action: 'Activates.' }]");
			}
			const apiNames: string[] = [];
			if (d.api !== undefined) {
				const ok = Array.isArray(d.api) && d.api.every((x) => x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x) && isNonEmptyString(x.name) && isNonEmptyString(x.type) && isNonEmptyString(x.description));
				if (!ok) err('doc/api', docFile, line, 'api entries need non-empty name, type and description', "api: [{ name: 'toast(message)', type: '(m: string) => string', description: '…' }]");
				else for (const x of d.api as { name: string }[]) apiNames.push(x.name.split(/[(<\s.]/)[0]);
			}
			for (const e of a.exports) {
				if (e.isType || e.svelteFile) continue;
				if (!apiNames.includes(e.name))
					warn('doc/api-missing', docFile, line, `non-component export "${e.name}" is not in doc.api`, `api: [{ name: '${e.name}(…)', type: '…', description: '…' }]`);
			}
			if (d.related !== undefined) {
				if (!Array.isArray(d.related) || !d.related.every(isNonEmptyString)) err('doc/related', docFile, line, 'related must be an array of slugs', "related: ['icon-button']");
				else for (const r of d.related as string[]) if (!ctx.slugs.has(r)) warn('doc/related', docFile, line, `related slug "${r}" does not exist (yet)`, 'check the slug, or wait for that kit to land');
			}
			if (d.status !== undefined && d.status !== 'stable' && d.status !== 'beta') err('doc/status', docFile, line, `status is ${JSON.stringify(d.status)}`, "status: 'stable' | 'beta'");
		}
	}

	// ── coverage (rule 5)
	if (a.examples.length) {
		const corpus = a.examples.map((e) => e.source).join('\n');
		for (const p of a.parts) {
			for (const prop of p.props) {
				if (EXEMPT.has(prop.name)) continue;
				if (!new RegExp(`\\b${escapeRe(prop.name)}\\b`).test(corpus))
					err('coverage/prop', f(p.file), prop.line, `prop "${prop.name}" of ${p.name} appears in no example`, `use ${prop.name} in an example (examples/NN-….svelte)`);
				for (const v of prop.resolvedValues ?? []) {
					if (!corpus.includes(`'${v}'`) && !corpus.includes(`"${v}"`) && !corpus.includes('`' + v + '`'))
						err('coverage/value', f(p.file), prop.line, `${prop.name}="${v}" appears in no example`, `show ${prop.name}="${v}" (a literal array like {#each ['${v}', …] as v} counts)`);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// ── Law 1 + imports on every file of the folder (rules 6, 7)
	const files = [...a.svelteFiles, ...a.tsFiles].map((n) => path.join(a.ref.dir, n));
	for (const e of a.examples) files.push(e.full);
	for (const sub of listDir(a.ref.dir, 'dir')) {
		if (sub === 'examples') continue;
		files.push(...walkFiles(path.join(a.ref.dir, sub), (n) => n.endsWith('.svelte') || n.endsWith('.ts')));
	}
	for (const full of files) out.push(...checkFile(full, ctx.allow));
	return out;
}

// ── styles + library ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function checkKitFragments(layers: LayerBuild, kits: KitInfo[], onlyKit: string | null): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	for (const fl of layers.files) {
		if (!fl.name.startsWith('kits/')) continue;
		const kit = fl.name.slice(5).replace(/\.css$/, '');
		if (onlyKit && kit !== onlyKit) continue;
		const file = rel(fl.full);
		const n = cssCodeLines(fl.source);
		if (n > KIT_BUDGET)
			out.push({ rule: 'layer/budget', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `${n} lines (budget ${KIT_BUDGET})`, fix: 'compose more in markup; keep only the smallest general primitives' });
		if (!kits.some((k) => k.id === kit))
			out.push({ rule: 'kit/unknown', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `kit fragment for unknown kit "${kit}"`, fix: 'name the fragment after a kit in kits.ts' });
		for (const m of fl.source.matchAll(/&/g)) {
			out.push({ rule: 'layer/nesting', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(fl.source, m.index ?? 0), message: '`&` nesting in a plain CSS layer', fix: 'write the selector out in full' });
			break;
		}
	}
	return out;
}

/** Law 1 + imports for src/lib outside the component folders. */
export function checkLibraryFiles(allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const files = walkFiles(PATHS.lib, (n) => n.endsWith('.ts') || n.endsWith('.svelte')).filter((full) => {
		const r = rel(full);
		return !r.startsWith('src/lib/components/') && !r.startsWith('src/lib/docs/generated/') && r !== 'src/lib/index.ts';
	});
	for (const full of files) out.push(...checkFile(full, allow));
	out.push(...checkTokenMaps(allow));
	return out;
}
```

</details>

## 0. Commands

| | |
|:---|:---|
| `pnpm dev` | the docs site (every component page is generated from the component folder) |
| `pnpm gen` | regenerate everything generated: `custom.css`, spring tokens, the barrel, `api.json` |
| `pnpm verify <kit>/<name>` | gen + gate + lint + type-check for ONE component — run this before you say "done" |
| `pnpm verify <kit>` | the same, for a whole kit |
| `pnpm gate` | the component↔docs contract for the whole library |
| `pnpm lint` | the fractalstyler closed-world linter |
| `pnpm check` | gen + svelte-check + lint + gate (the whole tree) |
| `pnpm build` | docs site + the publishable package |

Node 26, pnpm 11, Svelte 5.57 (runes only), SvelteKit 3, TypeScript 6 strict.

## 1. The two laws

### Law 1 — fractalstyler only

Styling is **composition of registered classes in markup**. Nothing else.

- NO `<style>` blocks. NO `style="…"`. NO `style:prop` directives.
- NO raw hex colours, NO pixel literals above 2px, NO literal `border-radius`.
- NO inline `<svg>` and NO unicode glyph icons — icons are
  `import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons'` +
  `import { luCheck } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide'` → `<Icon icon={luCheck} />`.
  (Check a name exists: `grep -c "luName\b" node_modules/@fractaldesign/icons/dist/lucide.d.ts`.)
- Every class must exist in **fractalstyler's registry**
  (`node_modules/@fractaldesign/fractalstyler/registry.md` — read it) or in the
  **maxima extension layer** (`src/lib/styles/layers/*.css` — read them; they
  are short).
- Modifiers are never standalone: `.row.xcenter`, never a bare `.xcenter`.
- There is no `.w-*`, `.pad-x-*`, `.border-top`. Search the registry; never guess.

**Dynamic values travel through custom properties.** JavaScript may write
*only* custom properties — `node.style.setProperty('--x', …)` — and a class
owns the real property (`translate: calc(var(--mx, 0) * 1px) …`). Use the
`vars()` attachment (`src/lib/motion`) to bind values:
`<div class="fill" {@attach vars({ value: 0.4 })}>`. Never assign
`node.style.transform = …` or any real property.

**The extension layer is small on purpose.** Compose first. If the system
genuinely cannot express something, add the *smallest general primitive* to
your kit's fragment `src/lib/styles/layers/kits/<kit>.css`:

- plain CSS, tokens only (`var(--space-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, colour roles),
  `rem`/`em`/`%` — no px above 2, no hex, no `&` nesting;
- named in the system's voice (`.track`, `.thumb`, `.indicator`) — a
  primitive several components could use, not `.my-component-inner`;
- hard budget: **90 lines per kit fragment**. The gate fails above it;
- only edit your own kit's fragment. Never edit `custom.css` (generated) or
  another layer file. After editing run `pnpm gen`.

### Law 2 — a component and its documentation are one

A component is a **folder**. It is not done until the folder passes
`pnpm verify <kit>/<name>`:

```
src/lib/components/<kit>/<name>/        # <name> is kebab-case
  <Name>.svelte                         # the primary component (PascalCase of <name>)
  <NamePart>.svelte …                   # optional further parts (DialogTitle.svelte)
  <name>.svelte.ts | <name>.ts          # optional logic/state modules
  index.ts                              # named exports of every public thing
  doc.ts                                # the documentation manifest
  examples/01-usage.svelte              # ≥ 1, ordered by numeric prefix
  examples/02-….svelte
```

The docs page is **generated** from that folder — you never write a route:

- **Install / import** — generated from the package name and `index.ts`.
- **Examples** — each example file is rendered live *and* shown as source
  (the same file, so demo and code cannot drift).
- **API tables** — extracted from each part's `interface Props` and its JSDoc.
- **Accessibility / keyboard** — from `doc.ts`.

What the gate requires:

1. `index.ts` exports the primary component and every part
   (`export { default as Button } from './Button.svelte';`).
2. Every exported `.svelte` part declares `interface Props` in its instance
   script. **Every prop has a JSDoc comment** (one sentence or more). Defaults
   are documented by the destructuring default or an explicit `@default` tag.
3. `doc.ts` default-exports `defineDoc({...})` (shape below), nothing empty

## 4. House rules

- fractalstyler is consumed from `../fractalstyler` (linked). **Never edit

- Do not initialise git, commit, push or publish unless the user asks.

## 5. Motion and theme quick reference

Import inside `src/lib` from `'../../../motion/index.js'` / `'../../../theme/index.js'`;
in examples from `'@fractaldesign/maxima-ui/motion'` / `'/theme'` (also re-exported
from the root). Read the sources for the full JSDoc.

```ts
// springs — presets: 'gentle' | 'snappy' | 'bouncy' | 'stiff' | 'slow', or { stiffness, damping, mass }
springs, resolveSpring(input?), springDuration(input?), springEasing(input?), springEase(input?)

// engine — element must carry class "motion" (x y scale rotate opacity) or "tilt" (rotateX rotateY)
animate(node, { x, y, scale, rotate, opacity, rotateX, rotateY, '--custom': n }, { spring, instant, onUpdate }) → { finished, stop() }
setMotion(node, values)   getMotion(node, channel)
new SpringValue(initial, spring?)  → .current (reactive) .target .set(v, { instant })
reducedMotion.current

// attachments — {@attach name(options)}
vars({ value: 0.4 })                    // writes --value (any custom properties)
press() hover() magnetic() tilt()       // interaction springs
pointer()                               // writes --px/--py for spotlights
inView({ class: 'in' }) reveal() stagger()   // entrance; stagger writes --i on children
drag({ axis, bounds, snapBack, momentum, onDragEnd })
parallax() scrollProgress()
createFlip() → { attach, read(), play(), run(fn) }   // FLIP layout springs; items carry data-flip-id

// Svelte transitions with spring easing — transition:springScale={{ spring: 'bouncy' }}
springFade springFly springScale springBlur springSlide

// view transitions
startViewTransition(update, { type: 'fade'|'slide'|'slide-back'|'scale'|'reveal'|'none', origin })
setupViewTransitions(onNavigate, { type })    vtName('hero')   // element also needs class "vt-name"

// theme
theme (ThemeState: mode theme hue chroma tint radius density motion resolvedMode; setTheme() setMode() toggleMode(event) reset())
themes, initTheme(), themeInitScript()
```

CSS side (see `src/lib/styles/layers/10-motion.css`): `.spring` + `.spring-<preset>`
for state transitions, `.pop` + `.enter-*` for anything that opens (works on
`[popover]`, `<dialog open>`, and `.open`), `.anim-in` (staggered by `--i`),
`.reveal`/`.in`, `.lift`, `.press`.

98	   are documented by the destructuring default or an explicit `@default` tag.

100	4. Each example starts with the header line
101	   `<!-- @example Title :: One sentence describing what it shows. -->`
102	   and example 01 is the minimal usage.

111	   import only from `@fractaldesign/maxima-ui` (and `/motion`, `/theme`),

114	### `doc.ts`
115	
116	```ts
117	import { defineDoc } from '../../../docs/define.js';
118	
119	export default defineDoc({
120		name: 'Button',                       // the primary export
121		summary: 'One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header.',
122		description: `One to three paragraphs. Blank line = new paragraph. \`code\` allowed.`,
123		parts: { ButtonGroup: 'One line: what this part is for.' },   // optional, every non-primary .svelte export
124		features: ['Spring-pressed', '…'],    // optional bullets
125		accessibility: ['Renders a native <button> …'],               // ≥ 1
126		keyboard: [{ keys: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Activates the button.' }],   // when interactive
127		api: [{ name: 'toast(message, options?)', type: '(…) => string', description: '…' }], // non-component exports

131	
132	## 2. Authoring conventions
133	
134	```svelte
135	<script lang="ts">
136		import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
137		import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
138		import { sizeClass, type Size, type Shape, type Variant } from '../../../internal/tokens.js';
139	
140		interface Props extends HTMLButtonAttributes {
141			/** The visual style of the button. */
142			variant?: Variant;
143			/** The control height and text scale. */
144			size?: Size;
145			/** The content. */
146			children?: Snippet;
147		}
148	
149		let { variant = 'primary', size = 'md', class: klass, children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
150	</script>
151	
152	<button class={['button', variant, sizeClass[size], klass]} {...rest}>
153		{@render children?.()}
154	</button>
155	```
156	
157	- Runes only: `$props`, `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$bindable`,
158	  `$props.id()` for ids. Snippets, never slots. `{@attach}`, never `use:`.
159	  Callback props (`onchange`), never `createEventDispatcher`.
160	- `class` is always accepted and merged last via the array form
161	  `class={['…', cond && '…', klass]}`. Spread `...rest` onto the root element
162	  and extend the matching `svelte/elements` attribute type.
163	- Two-way state is `$bindable()` **and** has a callback
164	  (`value = $bindable()`, `onValueChange`). Works controlled and uncontrolled.
165	- Shared axes come from `src/lib/internal/tokens.ts` — do not redefine:
166	  `Variant` (`primary secondary themed outline ghost link soft info success
167	  warning danger`), `Size` (`xs sm md lg xl` → `sizeClass[size]`), `Shape`
168	  (`rect mincurved modern curved round`), `Tone` (`neutral info success
169	  warning danger`), `Placement`.
170	- Compound components share state with `createContext` from `svelte`
171	  (`const [getTabs, setTabs] = createContext<TabsState>()`).
172	- Use the platform first: native `<dialog>`, the Popover API (`popover`
173	  attribute), CSS anchor positioning (`.anchor` / `.floating`, see
174	  `src/lib/internal/floating.ts`), `<details>`, `:has()`, `@starting-style`
175	  enter/exit (`.pop` + `.enter-*`). JavaScript only where the platform stops.
176	- SSR-safe: no `window`/`document` at module or init time — only inside
177	  `$effect`, attachments and event handlers.
178	- Accessible by construction: correct roles, `aria-*` wiring, labels, focus
179	  management, full keyboard support (document it in `doc.ts`).
180	- Motion (all from `src/lib/motion`): springs for anything a user moves or
181	  triggers; honour reduced motion (the motion layer already does — do not
182	  bypass it). Prefer CSS spring tokens (`.spring.snappy`, `.pop`) for
183	  state-driven motion; the JS spring engine (`animate`, `SpringValue`, the
184	  attachments) for gestures and layout.

# DESIGN

The design language of maxima-ui. It is fractalstyler's language, held to a
premium bar — restrained, precise, quiet until touched.

## Principles

1. **Composition over invention.** A component is a sentence written in
   fractalstyler's vocabulary. If two components look related, it is because
   they share classes, not because someone matched them by eye.
2. **Hierarchy through ink, not size.** `text-primary` → `text-secondary` →
   `text-muted` carry most hierarchy. Size and weight change rarely.
3. **Hairlines and light.** Surfaces are separated by 1px borders
   (`border`, `border-subtle`) and lifted by the elevation ladder (`shad-*`)
   with a lit top edge (`rim`). Floating surfaces are `glass`.
4. **Motion is physics.** Anything a person moves or triggers is driven by a
   spring — the same solver produces the CSS `linear()` tokens
   (`--spring-snappy` …) and drives the JavaScript engine, so a CSS transition
   and a dragged element settle the same way. Motion is interruptible, never
   blocks input, and collapses to nothing under reduced motion.
5. **One theme, three numbers.** `--hue`, `--chroma`, `--tint` generate every
   colour role in both modes. Shape (`data-radius`), density (`data-density`)
   and motion (`data-motion`) are independent axes that rewrite ladders, not
   components.

## The shared axes

| Axis | Values | Mechanism |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `variant` | primary · secondary · themed · soft · outline · ghost · link · info · success · warning · danger | a class of the same name |
| `size` | xs · sm · md · lg · xl | `sizeClass[size]` → height + text ladder |
| `shape` | rect · mincurved · modern · curved · round | a class of the same name |
| `tone` | neutral · info · success · warning · danger | status colour roles |

## The extension layer

| Layer | Adds |
|:---|:---|
| `00-tokens` | motion channels (`@property`), spring/motion scale, measure ladder |
| `01-springs` | generated `--spring-*` `linear()` easings |
| `10-motion` | `.motion` `.tilt` `.spring` `.pop` `.enter-*` `.anim-*` `.reveal`, view transitions |
| `20-surface` | `.glass` `.rim` `.glow` `.soft` `.measure-*` and small layout primitives |
| `30-overlay` | `.anchor` `.floating` `.dialog` `.sheet` `.layer` |
| `40-controls` | `.bare` `.item` `.track` `.fill` `.thumb` `.ring` `.indicator` `.caret` |
| `60-themes` | the parametric theme and the radius / density / motion axes |
| `kits/*` | ≤ 90 lines per kit, for primitives composition cannot express |

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAnchorAttributes, HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import type { IconData } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import { luLoaderCircle } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide';
	import { press } from '../../../motion/index.js';
	import { sizeClass, type Shape, type Size, type Variant } from '../../../internal/tokens.js';

	interface Props extends HTMLButtonAttributes {
		/** The visual style. `primary` is the page's main action; use one per view. */
		variant?: Variant;
		/** The control height and text scale. */
		size?: Size;
		/** The corner shape. */
		shape?: Shape;
		/** An icon drawn before the label. */
		icon?: IconData;
		/** An icon drawn after the label. */
		iconEnd?: IconData;
		/** Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon and blocks interaction, keeping the button's width. */
		loading?: boolean;
		/** Stretches the button to the full width of its container. */
		block?: boolean;
		/** Renders an `<a>` that looks like a button. Use for navigation. */
		href?: string;
		/** Where to open the link, when `href` is set. */
		target?: HTMLAnchorAttributes['target'];
		/** Springs the button down under the pointer. Turn off for a still button. */
		pressable?: boolean;
		/** The label. */
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		variant = 'primary',
		size = 'md',
		shape = 'modern',
		icon,
		iconEnd,
		loading = false,
		block = false,
		href,
		target,
		pressable = true,
		disabled,
		type = 'button',
		class: klass,
		children,
		...rest
	}: Props = $props();

	const classes = $derived([
		'button no-scaling gap-sm weight-500',
		variant,
		sizeClass[size],
		shape,
		block ? 'wfull' : 'inline-flex',
		pressable && 'motion',
		klass
	]);
	const spring = $derived(pressable ? press() : undefined);
</script>

{#snippet content()}
	{#if loading}
		<Icon icon={luLoaderCircle} class="anim-spin" />
	{:else if icon}
		<Icon {icon} />
	{/if}
	{@render children?.()}
	{#if iconEnd}
		<Icon icon={iconEnd} />
	{/if}
{/snippet}

{#if href && !disabled}
	<a
		class={classes}
		{href}
		{target}
		rel={target === '_blank' ? 'noopener noreferrer' : undefined}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest as HTMLAnchorAttributes}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</a>
{:else}
	<button
		class={classes}
		{type}
		disabled={disabled || loading}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</button>
{/if}

import { defineDoc } from '../../../docs/define.js';

export default defineDoc({
	name: 'Button',
	summary: 'Triggers an action or navigates, with a spring-loaded press.',
	description: `The button is the library's reference component: eleven variants, five sizes and five shapes, all of them plain fractalstyler classes, so a button always matches the inputs, tags and cards around it.

It renders a native \`<button>\` — or an \`<a>\` when you pass \`href\` — and forwards every attribute and event to it. Pressing it drives a real spring through the motion channel rather than a CSS keyframe, so a quick tap and a long hold both feel right.`,
	features: [
		'Eleven variants, five sizes, five shapes — shared with every other control',
		'Leading and trailing icons from @fractaldesign/icons',
		'Loading state that keeps the layout stable',
		'Renders a link when given href',
		'Interruptible spring press, disabled under reduced motion'
	],
	accessibility: [
		'Renders a native <button> (or <a> with href), so role, focus and activation come from the platform.',
		'While loading, the button is disabled and exposes aria-busy="true".',
		'An icon-only button needs an aria-label; icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.',
		'The focus ring is drawn only for keyboard focus (:focus-visible).'
	],
	keyboard: [
		{ keys: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Activates the button.' },
		{ keys: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus to the next focusable element.' }
	]
});

import type { Attachment } from 'svelte/attachments';

/** The CSS anchor name for an id — `$props.id()` output is a fine id. */
export function anchorName(id: string): string {
	return `--anchor-${id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')}`;
}

/**
 * Pair a trigger with its floating element. Put `{@attach anchor(id)}` on the
 * trigger (with class `anchor`) and `{@attach floating(id)}` on the floating
 * element (with class `floating at-…`): both receive the same `--anchor`
 * name, and CSS anchor positioning does the rest.
 */
export function anchor(id: string): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		node.style.setProperty('--anchor', anchorName(id));
		return () => node.style.removeProperty('--anchor');
	};
}

/** The floating side of `anchor()`. `offset` overrides the gap (any CSS length or token). */
export function floating(id: string, offset?: string): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		node.style.setProperty('--anchor', anchorName(id));
		if (offset) node.style.setProperty('--offset', offset);
		return () => {
			node.style.removeProperty('--anchor');
			node.style.removeProperty('--offset');
		};
	};
}

/**
 * Keep a boolean in step with a native popover element.
 * Returns an attachment for the `[popover]` element: it shows/hides the
 * popover when `isOpen()` changes and reports user dismissal through `onChange`.
 */
export function popoverSync(
	isOpen: () => boolean,
	onChange: (open: boolean) => void
): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		const want = isOpen();
		const shown = node.matches(':popover-open');
		if (want && !shown) node.showPopover();
		else if (!want && shown) node.hidePopover();

		const onToggle = (event: Event) => {
			const next = (event as ToggleEvent).newState === 'open';
			if (next !== isOpen()) onChange(next);
		};
		node.addEventListener('toggle', onToggle);

/** The documentation manifest of one component folder. See AGENTS.md, Law 2. */
export interface ComponentDoc {
	/** The primary export, PascalCase — `Button`. */
	name: string;
	/** One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header. */
	summary: string;
	/** One to three paragraphs. A blank line starts a new paragraph; `code` is allowed. */
	description: string;
	/** Every non-primary component export → one line on what it is for. */
	parts?: Record<string, string>;
	/** Short capability bullets. */
	features?: string[];
	/** How the component is accessible — at least one statement. */
	accessibility: string[];
	/** Keyboard interactions, when the component is interactive. */
	keyboard?: { keys: string; action: string }[];
	/** Non-component exports: functions, attachments, classes, stores. */
	api?: { name: string; type: string; description: string }[];
	/** Slugs of related components. */
	related?: string[];
	status?: 'stable' | 'beta';
}

export function defineDoc(doc: ComponentDoc): ComponentDoc {
	return doc;
}
