const NUMBER = /^(?:0[xXbBoO][\da-fA-F_]+n?|\d[\d_]*(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?n?|\.\d+(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)/;
const OPERATORS = /^[{}()[\];,.<>=+\-*/%!&|^~?:@#]+/;

/** Index of the `}` closing the `{` at `open` (string- and template-aware); -1 if none. */
function closeBrace(src: string, open: number): number {
	let depth = 0;
	for (let i = open; i < src.length; i++) {
		const c = src[i];
		if (c === '"' || c === "'") i = endOfQuote(src, i);
		else if (c === '`') i = endOfTemplate(src, i);
		else if (c === '{') depth++;
		else if (c === '}') {
			depth--;

/** Index of the closing quote of the string at `i` (or the end of the line / input). */
function endOfQuote(src: string, i: number): number {

function endOfTemplate(src: string, i: number): number {

import type { Attachment } from 'svelte/attachments';

type MotionNode = HTMLElement | SVGElement;

const passive: AddEventListenerOptions = { passive: true };

/** A job in the shared scroll frame: every `read` runs before any `write`. */
interface FrameJob {

	write(): void;

const scrollJobs = new Set<FrameJob>();
let scrollFrame = 0;

function runScrollFrame(): void {
	scrollFrame = 0;

	for (const job of jobs) job.read();

// The gate's rules. Each check returns diagnostics; nothing here throws on bad input.

import ts from 'typescript';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { ComponentAnalysis, KitInfo } from './analysis.ts';
import { parseTs } from './api.ts';
import type { LayerBuild } from './css.ts';
import { extractScripts, markupOf, matchJsBrace, skipQuoted, stringLiterals } from './svelte.ts';
import { PATHS, closest, cssCodeLines, escapeRe, lineAt, listDir, readText, rel, walkFiles } from './util.ts';

export interface Diag {
	rule: string;
	severity: 'error' | 'warning';
	file: string;
	line: number | null;
	message: string;
	fix: string;
}

export const KIT_BUDGET = 90;

// ── the class allowlist ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Allowlist {
	classes: Set<string>;
	stems: string[];
	registryFound: boolean;
}

export function loadAllowlist(layers: LayerBuild): Allowlist {
	const classes = new Set<string>();
	const stems: string[] = [];
	const raw = readText(PATHS.fsRegistry);
	let registryFound = false;
	if (raw) {
		try {
			const rows = JSON.parse(raw) as { class?: string }[];
			registryFound = Array.isArray(rows);
			for (const row of Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []) {
				const name = (row.class ?? '').replace(/^\./, '').trim();
				if (!name) continue;
				if (name.includes('*')) stems.push(name.replace(/\*.*$/, ''));
				else classes.add(name);
			}
		} catch {
			registryFound = false;
		}
	}
	for (const c of layers.harvested) classes.add(c);
	return { classes, stems, registryFound };
}

export function isAllowed(cls: string, allow: Allowlist): boolean {
	return allow.classes.has(cls) || allow.stems.some((s) => cls.startsWith(s)) || /-(mob|desk)$/.test(cls);
}

function unknownClass(cls: string, file: string, line: number, allow: Allowlist): Diag {
	const near = closest(cls, allow.classes, 3);
	return {
		rule: 'class/unknown',
		severity: 'error',
		file,
		line,
		message: `class "${cls}" is not in the fractalstyler registry or the maxima extension layer`,
		fix: near.length
			? `did you mean ${near.map((n) => `"${n}"`).join(', ')}? (registry.md / src/lib/styles/layers)`
			: 'compose from registry.md, or add the smallest general primitive to your kit fragment'
	};
}

// ── class tokens in markup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

const CLASSY = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/;
const COMPARE_BEFORE = /(===|!==|==|!=|\bin|\bcase)\s*$/;
const COMPARE_AFTER = /^\s*(===|!==|==|!=|in\b)/;

/** Class-looking tokens of the string literals inside a JS expression (comparison operands skipped). */
function expressionClassTokens(expr: string): { token: string; offset: number }[] {
	const out: { token: string; offset: number }[] = [];
	for (const lit of stringLiterals(expr)) {
		if (lit.interpolated) continue;
		// comparison operands (`x === 'vertical'`), `case 'x':` labels and `'x' in o` are not class lists
		if (COMPARE_BEFORE.test(expr.slice(0, lit.start)) || COMPARE_AFTER.test(expr.slice(lit.end))) continue;
		let pos = 0;
		for (const tok of lit.value.split(/(\s+)/)) {
			if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok) && CLASSY.test(tok)) out.push({ token: tok, offset: lit.start + 1 + pos });
			pos += tok.length;
		}
	}
	return out;
}

interface ScriptVar {
	init: string;
	offset: number;
}

/** `const x = …` / `let x = …` initialisers of the instance script, by name. */
function scriptVars(src: string): Map<string, ScriptVar> {
	const out = new Map<string, ScriptVar>();
	for (const s of extractScripts(src)) {
		const sf = parseTs(s.content, 'vars.ts');

			if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(n) && ts.isIdentifier(n.name) && n.initializer) {
				const start = n.initializer.getStart(sf);
				out.set(n.name.text, { init: n.initializer.getText(sf), offset: s.offset + start });
			}
			ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
		};
		visit(sf);
	}
	return out;
}

	};
	const checkExpr = (expr: string, base: number) => {
		for (const t of expressionClassTokens(expr)) check(t.token, base + t.offset);
		// identifiers that name script variables: check their initialisers too
		for (const m of expr.matchAll(/(?<![\w$.'"`-])([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(?![\w$])/g)) {
			const v = vars.get(m[1]);
			if (!v || checked.has(m[1])) continue;
			checked.add(m[1]);
			for (const t of expressionClassTokens(v.init)) check(t.token, v.offset + t.offset);
		}
	};

	const ATTR = /(?<=[\s])class\s*=\s*/g;
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(ATTR)) {
		const at = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
		const q = markup[at];
		if (q === '"' || q === "'") {
			let i = at + 1;
			let staticText = '';
			while (i < markup.length && markup[i] !== q) {
				if (markup[i] === '{') {
					const close = matchJsBrace(markup, i);
					if (close < 0) break;
					checkExpr(markup.slice(i + 1, close), i + 1);
					staticText += ' '.repeat(close - i + 1);
					i = close + 1;
					continue;
				}
				staticText += markup[i];
				i++;
			}
			let pos = 0;
			for (const tok of staticText.split(/(\s+)/)) {
				if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok)) check(tok, at + 1 + pos);
				pos += tok.length;
			}
		} else if (q === '{') {
			const close = matchJsBrace(markup, at);
			if (close > at) checkExpr(markup.slice(at + 1, close), at + 1);
		}
	}
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(/(?<=[\s])class:([\w-]+)/g)) check(m[1], m.index ?? 0);
	return out;
}

/** String literals of the exported `Record<…, string>` maps in tokens.ts. */
export function checkTokenMaps(allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const src = readText(PATHS.tokensTs);
	if (!src) return [];
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(src, 'tokens.ts');
	for (const st of sf.statements) {
		if (!ts.isVariableStatement(st) || !st.modifiers?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword)) continue;
		for (const d of st.declarationList.declarations) {
			if (!d.type || !/^Record</.test(d.type.getText(sf)) || !d.initializer || !ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(d.initializer)) continue;
			for (const p of d.initializer.properties) {
				if (!ts.isPropertyAssignment(p) || !ts.isStringLiteral(p.initializer)) continue;
				for (const tok of p.initializer.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) {
					if (!isAllowed(tok, allow)) {
						out.push(unknownClass(tok, rel(PATHS.tokensTs), sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(p.getStart(sf)).line + 1, allow));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out;
}

// ── Law 1: no styles, no svg, JS writes only custom properties ──────────────

function startsWithDashes(arg: ts.Expression | undefined): boolean {
	if (!arg) return false;
	if (ts.isStringLiteral(arg) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(arg)) return arg.text.startsWith('--');
	if (ts.isTemplateExpression(arg)) return arg.head.text.startsWith('--');
	return false;
}

function isStyleAccess(n: ts.Expression): boolean {
	return (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n) && n.name.text === 'style') || (ts.isElementAccessExpression(n) && ts.isStringLiteral(n.argumentExpression) && n.argumentExpression.text === 'style');
}

/** AST checks on one script / TS module. */
export function checkScriptAst(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, inMotion: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(code, path.basename(file) + '.ts');
	const line = (n: ts.Node) => lineBase + sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart(sf)).line;
	const push = (n: ts.Node, message: string, fix: string) =>
		out.push({ rule: 'style/js-write', severity: 'error', file, line: line(n), message, fix });
	const CP_FIX = "write a custom property — node.style.setProperty('--x', v) or the vars() attachment — and let a class own the real property";

	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isBinaryExpression(n) && n.operatorToken.kind >= ts.SyntaxKind.FirstAssignment && n.operatorToken.kind <= ts.SyntaxKind.LastAssignment) {
			const left = n.left;
			if (isStyleAccess(left)) push(n, 'assigns element.style directly', CP_FIX);
			else if ((ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) || ts.isElementAccessExpression(left)) && isStyleAccess(left.expression)) {
				const prop = ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) ? left.name.text : left.argumentExpression.getText(sf);
				push(n, prop === 'cssText' ? 'writes .style.cssText' : `assigns .style.${prop.replace(/['"]/g, '')}`, CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression)) {
			const method = n.expression.name.text;
			const target = n.expression.expression;
			if (method === 'setProperty' && isStyleAccess(target) && !startsWithDashes(n.arguments[0]) && !inMotion) {
				const lit = n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0]));
				push(
					n,
					lit ? `style.setProperty(${n.arguments[0].getText(sf)}) sets a real property` : 'style.setProperty() with a non-literal name (only src/lib/motion may)',
					"name a custom property literally: setProperty('--x', …)"
				);
			}
			if (method === 'setAttribute' && n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0])) && n.arguments[0].text.toLowerCase() === 'style') {
				push(n, "setAttribute('style', …)", CP_FIX);
			}
			if (method === 'assign' && target.getText(sf) === 'Object' && n.arguments[0] && isStyleAccess(n.arguments[0])) {
				push(n, 'Object.assign(element.style, …)', CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

// ── imports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const LIB_BARE = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?)$/;
const EXAMPLE_ALLOWED = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/maxima-ui(\/motion|\/theme)?)$/;

export function moduleSpecifiers(code: string): { spec: string; line: number }[] {
	const sf = parseTs(code, 'imports.ts');
	const out: { spec: string; line: number }[] = [];
	const add = (lit: ts.Expression | undefined) => {
		if (lit && ts.isStringLiteral(lit)) out.push({ spec: lit.text, line: sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(lit.getStart(sf)).line });
	};
	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isImportDeclaration(n) || ts.isExportDeclaration(n)) add(n.moduleSpecifier);
		else if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && n.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword) add(n.arguments[0]);
		else if (ts.isImportTypeNode(n) && ts.isLiteralTypeNode(n.argument)) add(n.argument.literal);
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

export function checkImports(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, isExample: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	for (const { spec, line } of moduleSpecifiers(code)) {
		let bad = false;
		let fix = '';
		if (isExample) {
			if (!EXAMPLE_ALLOWED.test(spec)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = "examples import exactly what a consumer writes: '@fractaldesign/maxima-ui' (/motion, /theme), '@fractaldesign/icons*', 'svelte*'";
			}
		} else if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
			const target = path.resolve(path.dirname(path.join(PATHS.root, file)), spec);
			if (!target.startsWith(PATHS.lib + path.sep)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = 'relative imports must stay inside src/lib';
			}
		} else if (!LIB_BARE.test(spec)) {
			bad = true;
			fix = "inside src/lib import relatively (no $lib, no #lib); only 'svelte*' and '@fractaldesign/icons*' are bare";
		}
		if (bad) out.push({ rule: 'import/forbidden', severity: 'error', file, line: lineBase + line, message: `import '${spec}'`, fix });
	}
	return out;
}

// ── per-file Law 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const GLYPHS = /[✓✔✗✘✕✖☰▾▴▸◂▶◀★☆⨯]/;

export function checkFile(full: string, allow: Allowlist | null): Diag[] {
	const file = rel(full);
	const src = readText(full);
	if (src === null) return [];
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const inMotion = full.startsWith(PATHS.motion + path.sep);
	const isExample = file.split('/').includes('examples');
	try {
		if (full.endsWith('.svelte')) {
			const noComments = src.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			const markup = markupOf(src);
			const styleBlock = noComments.search(/<style[\s>]/);
			if (styleBlock >= 0)
				out.push({ rule: 'style/block', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, styleBlock), message: '<style> block', fix: 'delete it; compose fractalstyler classes in markup' });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\sstyle\s*=/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/inline', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'style="…" attribute', fix: 'use classes; pass dynamic values as custom properties with the vars() attachment' });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\sstyle:([\w-]+)/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/inline', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: `style:${m[1]} directive`, fix: 'use classes; pass dynamic values as custom properties with the vars() attachment' });
			for (const m of noComments.matchAll(/<svg[\s>/]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/inline-svg', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'inline <svg>', fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
			// visible text only: strip tags and expressions
			const text = markup.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ')).replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			const g = text.search(GLYPHS);
			if (g >= 0)
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/glyph', severity: 'warning', file, line: lineAt(src, g), message: `unicode glyph "${text[g]}" used as an icon`, fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\.style\.(cssText|[a-zA-Z]+)\s*=(?!=)|setAttribute\(\s*['"`]style['"`]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/js-write', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: `writes a real style property in markup (${m[0].trim()})`, fix: "write a custom property — setProperty('--x', v) or vars()" });
			for (const s of extractScripts(src)) {
				out.push(...checkScriptAst(s.content, file, s.line, inMotion));
				out.push(...checkImports(s.content, file, s.line, isExample));
			}
			if (allow) out.push(...checkSvelteClasses(full, src, allow));
		} else if (full.endsWith('.ts')) {
			out.push(...checkScriptAst(src, file, 1, inMotion));
			out.push(...checkImports(src, file, 1, isExample));
			const noComments = src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			for (const m of noComments.matchAll(/<svg[\s>/]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/inline-svg', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'inline <svg> markup in a string', fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
		}
	} catch (err) {
		out.push({ rule: 'analysis/crash', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `could not analyse: ${(err as Error).message}`, fix: 'fix the syntax error' });
	}
	return out;
}

export function checkKitFragments(layers: LayerBuild, kits: KitInfo[], onlyKit: string | null): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	for (const fl of layers.files) {
		if (!fl.name.startsWith('kits/')) continue;
		const kit = fl.name.slice(5).replace(/\.css$/, '');
		if (onlyKit && kit !== onlyKit) continue;
		const file = rel(fl.full);
		const n = cssCodeLines(fl.source);
		if (n > KIT_BUDGET)
			out.push({ rule: 'layer/budget', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `${n} lines (budget ${KIT_BUDGET})`, fix: 'compose more in markup; keep only the smallest general primitives' });
		if (!kits.some((k) => k.id === kit))
			out.push({ rule: 'kit/unknown', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `kit fragment for unknown kit "${kit}"`, fix: 'name the fragment after a kit in kits.ts' });
		for (const m of fl.source.matchAll(/&/g)) {
			out.push({ rule: 'layer/nesting', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(fl.source, m.index ?? 0), message: '`&` nesting in a plain CSS layer', fix: 'write the selector out in full' });
			break;
		}
	}
	return out;
}

/** Law 1 + imports for src/lib outside the component folders. */
export function checkLibraryFiles(allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const files = walkFiles(PATHS.lib, (n) => n.endsWith('.ts') || n.endsWith('.svelte')).filter((full) => {
		const r = rel(full);
		return !r.startsWith('src/lib/components/') && !r.startsWith('src/lib/docs/generated/') && r !== 'src/lib/index.ts';
	});
	for (const full of files) out.push(...checkFile(full, allow));
	out.push(...checkTokenMaps(allow));
	return out;
}
// The extension layer: concatenation into custom.css, class harvesting, and a
// small brace-aware CSS parser (enough for plain, token-only stylesheets).

import path from 'node:path';
import { PATHS, blank, byCodepoint, cssCodeLines, lineAt, listDir, readText } from './util.ts';

export interface LayerFile {
	/** Path relative to the layers folder: `10-surfaces.css`, `kits/actions.css`. */
	name: string;
	full: string;
	source: string;
}

export interface CssRule {
	prelude: string;
	declarations: string[];

export interface ClassEntry {
	class: string;

}

export interface LayerSegment {
	file: string;
	/** First line of the segment's content in custom.css (1-based). */
	start: number;

export interface LayerBuild {
	files: LayerFile[];
	css: string;
	segments: LayerSegment[];
	classes: ClassEntry[];
	/** The class names fractalstyler's linter harvests from custom.css (parity with `lint`). */
	harvested: Set<string>;
	codeLines: number;
}

export function readLayers(): LayerFile[] {
	const out: LayerFile[] = [];
	for (const name of listDir(PATHS.layers, 'file').filter((n) => n.endsWith('.css'))) {
		const full = path.join(PATHS.layers, name);
		out.push({ name, full, source: readText(full) ?? '' });
	}
	for (const name of listDir(PATHS.kitLayers, 'file').filter((n) => n.endsWith('.css'))) {
		const full = path.join(PATHS.kitLayers, name);
		out.push({ name: `kits/${name}`, full, source: readText(full) ?? '' });
	}
	return out;
}

const BANNER =
	'/* GENERATED by scripts/gen.ts from src/lib/styles/layers/**.css — do not edit. Edit the layer files and run `pnpm gen`. */';

export function buildLayers(files: LayerFile[] = readLayers()): LayerBuild {
	const parts: string[] = [BANNER, ''];
	const segments: LayerSegment[] = [];
	let line = 3;
	for (const f of files) {
		const body = f.source.replace(/\s+$/, '');
		parts.push(`/* ── ${f.name} ── */`);
		line += 1;
		const n = body === '' ? 0 : body.split('\n').length;
		segments.push({ file: f.name, start: line, lines: n });
		if (n > 0) parts.push(body);
		parts.push('');
		line += n + 1;
	}
	const css = parts.join('\n');

	const seen = new Map<string, ClassEntry>();
	for (const f of files) {
		for (const entry of harvestRuleClasses(f.name, f.source)) {
			if (!seen.has(entry.class)) seen.set(entry.class, entry);
		}
	}
	const classes = [...seen.values()].sort((a, b) => byCodepoint(a.class, b.class));

	return {
		files,
		css,
		segments,
		classes,
		harvested: harvestLikeLinter(css),
		codeLines: files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + cssCodeLines(f.source), 0)
	};
}

/** Exactly the regex fractalstyler's `lint` uses on a consumer's custom.css. */
export function harvestLikeLinter(css: string): Set<string> {
	const names = new Set<string>();
	for (const m of css.matchAll(/(?:^|[\s,{}])(\.)([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)/g)) names.add(m[2]);
	return names;
}

/** Map a line of the generated custom.css back to its layer file. */
export function mapCustomLine(segments: LayerSegment[], line: number): { file: string; line: number } | null {
	for (const s of segments) {
		if (line >= s.start && line < s.start + s.lines) return { file: s.file, line: line - s.start + 1 };
	}
	return null;
}

// ── parser ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function stripComments(src: string): string {
	return src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, (m) => blank(m));
}

function skipString(src: string, i: number): number {
	const q = src[i];
	let j = i + 1;
	while (j < src.length && src[j] !== q) {
		if (src[j] === '\\') j++;
		j++;
	}
	return j;
}

function matchBrace(src: string, open: number): number {
	let depth = 0;
	for (let i = open; i < src.length; i++) {
		const c = src[i];
		if (c === '"' || c === "'") i = skipString(src, i);
		else if (c === '{') depth++;
		else if (c === '}') {
			depth--;
			if (depth === 0) return i;
		}
	}
	return src.length;
}

function parseBlock(src: string, from: number, to: number, full: string): { rules: CssRule[]; decls: string[] } {
	const rules: CssRule[] = [];
	const decls: string[] = [];
	let seg = from;
	let paren = 0;
	for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
		const c = src[i];
		if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
			i = skipString(src, i);
		} else if (c === '(') paren++;
		else if (c === ')') paren = Math.max(0, paren - 1);
		else if (c === ';' && paren === 0) {
			const d = src.slice(seg, i).trim();
			if (d) {
				// `@import …;` and friends at block level are statements, not declarations.
				if (!d.startsWith('@')) decls.push(d.replace(/\s+/g, ' '));
			}
			seg = i + 1;
		} else if (c === '{' && paren === 0) {
			const close = matchBrace(src, i);
			const prelude = src.slice(seg, i).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
			const inner = parseBlock(src, i + 1, Math.min(close, to), full);
			rules.push({ prelude, declarations: inner.decls, children: inner.rules, line: lineAt(full, seg + (src.slice(seg, i).length - src.slice(seg, i).trimStart().length)) });
			i = close;
			seg = close + 1;
		}
	}
	const tail = src.slice(seg, to).trim();
	if (tail && !tail.startsWith('@')) decls.push(tail.replace(/\s+/g, ' '));
	return { rules, decls };
}

export function parseCss(source: string): CssRule[] {
	const src = stripComments(source);
	return parseBlock(src, 0, src.length, source).rules;
}

const SKIP_AT = /^@(keyframes|-webkit-keyframes|font-face|property|counter-style|page|font-feature-values)\b/;

function harvestRuleClasses(file: string, source: string): ClassEntry[] {
	const out: ClassEntry[] = [];
	const visit = (rules: CssRule[]) => {
		for (const r of rules) {
			if (r.prelude.startsWith('@')) {
				if (!SKIP_AT.test(r.prelude)) visit(r.children);
				continue;
			}
			const names = new Set<string>();
			for (const m of r.prelude.matchAll(/\.(-?[a-zA-Z_][\w-]*)/g)) names.add(m[1]);
			for (const name of names) {
				out.push({ class: name, file, selector: r.prelude, declarations: r.declarations.join('; ') });
			}
			visit(r.children);
		}
	};
	visit(parseCss(source));
	return out;
}

// pnpm verify <kit>[/<name>] — gen + gate + fractalstyler lint + svelte-check, scoped.
// Quiet, fast, and robust to other folders being broken: only diagnostics under the
// scope (and the kit's style fragment) count.

import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
import { mapCustomLine } from './lib/css.ts';
import { formatGate, parseScope, runGate } from './lib/gate-core.ts';
import { runGen } from './lib/generate.ts';
import { PATHS, ROOT, rel } from './lib/util.ts';

const arg = process.argv.slice(2).find((a) => !a.startsWith('-'));
if (!arg) {
	console.log('usage: pnpm verify <kit>[/<name>]');
	process.exit(2);
}
const scope = parseScope(arg);
const prefix = `src/lib/components/${scope.kit}/${scope.name ? scope.name + '/' : ''}`;
const fragment = `src/lib/styles/layers/kits/${scope.kit}.css`;
const inScope = (file: string) => {
	const f = file.split(path.sep).join('/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
	return f.startsWith(prefix) || f === fragment;
};

function run(cmd: string, args: string[]): Promise<{ code: number; stdout: string; stderr: string }> {
	return new Promise((resolve) => {
		const child = spawn(cmd, args, { cwd: ROOT, env: { ...process.env, FORCE_COLOR: '0' } });
		let stdout = '';
		let stderr = '';
		child.stdout.on('data', (d) => (stdout += d));
		child.stderr.on('data', (d) => (stderr += d));
		child.on('error', (e) => resolve({ code: 127, stdout, stderr: stderr + e.message }));
		child.on('close', (code) => resolve({ code: code ?? 1, stdout, stderr }));
	});
}

let failed = false;
const out: string[] = [];

// 1. gen
const gen = await runGen();
const genBad = gen.results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
out.push(genBad.length ? `⚠ gen      ${genBad.map((r) => r.summary).join('; ')}` : `✔ gen`);

// 2. gate (scoped)
const gate = await runGate(scope, { lib: gen.lib, layers: gen.layers });
if (gate.errors || gate.scopeError) failed = true;
out.push(`${gate.errors || gate.scopeError ? '✘' : '✔'} gate`);
if (gate.errors || gate.warnings || gate.scopeError) out.push(formatGate(gate, { quiet: true }).replace(/^/gm, '  '));

This file is the **contract**. Every rule below is enforced by a script
(`pnpm gate`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check`). If a rule and a script disagree, the
script is the truth — fix the file, never the gate.

## 0. Commands

| | |
|:---|:---|
| `pnpm dev` | the docs site (every component page is generated from the component folder) |
| `pnpm gen` | regenerate everything generated: `custom.css`, spring tokens, the barrel, `api.json` |
| `pnpm verify <kit>/<name>` | gen + gate + lint + type-check for ONE component — run this before you say "done" |
| `pnpm verify <kit>` | the same, for a whole kit |
| `pnpm gate` | the component↔docs contract for the whole library |
| `pnpm lint` | the fractalstyler closed-world linter |
| `pnpm check` | gen + svelte-check + lint + gate (the whole tree) |
| `pnpm build` | docs site + the publishable package |

Node 26, pnpm 11, Svelte 5.57 (runes only), SvelteKit 3, TypeScript 6 strict.

## 1. The two laws

### Law 1 — fractalstyler only

Styling is **composition of registered classes in markup**. Nothing else.

- NO `<style>` blocks. NO `style="…"`. NO `style:prop` directives.
- NO raw hex colours, NO pixel literals above 2px, NO literal `border-radius`.
- NO inline `<svg>` and NO unicode glyph icons — icons are
  `import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons'` +
  `import { luCheck } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide'` → `<Icon icon={luCheck} />`.
  (Check a name exists: `grep -c "luName\b" node_modules/@fractaldesign/icons/dist/lucide.d.ts`.)
- Every class must exist in **fractalstyler's registry**
  (`node_modules/@fractaldesign/fractalstyler/registry.md` — read it) or in the
  **maxima extension layer** (`src/lib/styles/layers/*.css` — read them; they
  are short).
- Modifiers are never standalone: `.row.xcenter`, never a bare `.xcenter`.
- There is no `.w-*`, `.pad-x-*`, `.border-top`. Search the registry; never guess.

**Dynamic values travel through custom properties.** JavaScript may write
*only* custom properties — `node.style.setProperty('--x', …)` — and a class
owns the real property (`translate: calc(var(--mx, 0) * 1px) …`). Use the
`vars()` attachment (`src/lib/motion`) to bind values:
`<div class="fill" {@attach vars({ value: 0.4 })}>`. Never assign
`node.style.transform = …` or any real property.

**The extension layer is small on purpose.** Compose first. If the system
genuinely cannot express something, add the *smallest general primitive* to
your kit's fragment `src/lib/styles/layers/kits/<kit>.css`:

- plain CSS, tokens only (`var(--space-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, colour roles),
  `rem`/`em`/`%` — no px above 2, no hex, no `&` nesting;
- named in the system's voice (`.track`, `.thumb`, `.indicator`) — a
  primitive several components could use, not `.my-component-inner`;
- hard budget: **90 lines per kit fragment**. The gate fails above it;
- only edit your own kit's fragment. Never edit `custom.css` (generated) or
  another layer file. After editing run `pnpm gen`.

### Law 2 — a component and its documentation are one

A component is a **folder**. It is not done until the folder passes
`pnpm verify <kit>/<name>`:

```
src/lib/components/<kit>/<name>/        # <name> is kebab-case
  <Name>.svelte                         # the primary component (PascalCase of <name>)
  <NamePart>.svelte …                   # optional further parts (DialogTitle.svelte)
  <name>.svelte.ts | <name>.ts          # optional logic/state modules
  index.ts                              # named exports of every public thing
  doc.ts                                # the documentation manifest
  examples/01-usage.svelte              # ≥ 1, ordered by numeric prefix
  examples/02-….svelte
```

The docs page is **generated** from that folder — you never write a route:

- **Install / import** — generated from the package name and `index.ts`.
- **Examples** — each example file is rendered live *and* shown as source
  (the same file, so demo and code cannot drift).
- **API tables** — extracted from each part's `interface Props` and its JSDoc.
- **Accessibility / keyboard** — from `doc.ts`.

What the gate requires:

1. `index.ts` exports the primary component and every part
   (`export { default as Button } from './Button.svelte';`).
2. Every exported `.svelte` part declares `interface Props` in its instance
   script. **Every prop has a JSDoc comment** (one sentence or more). Defaults
   are documented by the destructuring default or an explicit `@default` tag.
3. `doc.ts` default-exports `defineDoc({...})` (shape below), nothing empty.
4. Each example starts with the header line
   `<!-- @example Title :: One sentence describing what it shows. -->`
   and example 01 is the minimal usage.
5. **Coverage — nothing is left out.** Across the folder's examples:
   every value of every string-literal-union prop (`variant`, `size`, `shape`,
   `placement`, …) appears; every prop name declared in `Props` (of every part)
   appears. (`class`, `children`, `ref` are exempt.)
6. Law 1, statically: no style blocks/attributes/directives, no `<svg`, no
   `.style.` writes other than `setProperty('--…')`, and every class token in a
   `class="…"` / `class={…}` literal is registered.
7. Inside `src/lib`, imports are **relative** (no `#lib`, no `$lib`). Examples
   import only from `@fractaldesign/maxima-ui` (and `/motion`, `/theme`),
   `@fractaldesign/icons*`, and `svelte*` — exactly what a consumer would write.

### `doc.ts`

```ts
import { defineDoc } from '../../../docs/define.js';

export default defineDoc({
	name: 'Button',                       // the primary export
	summary: 'One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header.',
	description: `One to three paragraphs. Blank line = new paragraph. \`code\` allowed.`,
	parts: { ButtonGroup: 'One line: what this part is for.' },   // optional, every non-primary .svelte export
	features: ['Spring-pressed', '…'],    // optional bullets
	accessibility: ['Renders a native <button> …'],               // ≥ 1
	keyboard: [{ keys: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Activates the button.' }],   // when interactive
	api: [{ name: 'toast(message, options?)', type: '(…) => string', description: '…' }], // non-component exports
	related: ['icon-button']              // optional slugs
});
```

## 2. Authoring conventions

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { sizeClass, type Size, type Shape, type Variant } from '../../../internal/tokens.js';

	interface Props extends HTMLButtonAttributes {
		/** The visual style of the button. */
		variant?: Variant;
		/** The control height and text scale. */
		size?: Size;
		/** The content. */
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let { variant = 'primary', size = 'md', class: klass, children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<button class={['button', variant, sizeClass[size], klass]} {...rest}>
	{@render children?.()}
</button>
```

- Runes only: `$props`, `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$bindable`,
  `$props.id()` for ids. Snippets, never slots. `{@attach}`, never `use:`.
  Callback props (`onchange`), never `createEventDispatcher`.
- `class` is always accepted and merged last via the array form
  `class={['…', cond && '…', klass]}`. Spread `...rest` onto the root element
  and extend the matching `svelte/elements` attribute type.
- Two-way state is `$bindable()` **and** has a callback
  (`value = $bindable()`, `onValueChange`). Works controlled and uncontrolled.
- Shared axes come from `src/lib/internal/tokens.ts` — do not redefine:
  `Variant` (`primary secondary themed outline ghost link soft info success
  warning danger`), `Size` (`xs sm md lg xl` → `sizeClass[size]`), `Shape`
  (`rect mincurved modern curved round`), `Tone` (`neutral info success
  warning danger`), `Placement`.
- Compound components share state with `createContext` from `svelte`
  (`const [getTabs, setTabs] = createContext<TabsState>()`).
- Use the platform first: native `<dialog>`, the Popover API (`popover`
  attribute), CSS anchor positioning (`.anchor` / `.floating`, see
  `src/lib/internal/floating.ts`), `<details>`, `:has()`, `@starting-style`
  enter/exit (`.pop` + `.enter-*`). JavaScript only where the platform stops.
- SSR-safe: no `window`/`document` at module or init time — only inside
  `$effect`, attachments and event handlers.
- Accessible by construction: correct roles, `aria-*` wiring, labels, focus
  management, full keyboard support (document it in `doc.ts`).
- Motion (all from `src/lib/motion`): springs for anything a user moves or
  triggers; honour reduced motion (the motion layer already does — do not
  bypass it). Prefer CSS spring tokens (`.spring.snappy`, `.pop`) for
  state-driven motion; the JS spring engine (`animate`, `SpringValue`, the
  attachments) for gestures and layout.
- No new dependencies. No `any`. No `@ts-ignore`. No TODOs.
- Aesthetic bar: restrained, precise, premium. Hairline borders, the
  elevation ladder, generous but consistent spacing from the space ladder,
  `text-secondary`/`text-muted` for hierarchy, `.rim` + `.shad-*` on raised
  surfaces, `.glass` on floating ones, tabular numerals for numbers. Examples
  use realistic content (real product copy, never "foo"/"Lorem ipsum").

## 3. Map

| | |
|:---|:---|
| `src/lib/styles/layers/*.css` | the maxima extension layer — sources. `kits/<kit>.css` are the kit fragments |
| `src/lib/styles/custom.css` | GENERATED concat of the layers — fractalstyler's sanctioned `custom.css` extension point; the linter reads it |
| `src/lib/internal/` | shared tokens, floating/anchor helpers, list navigation, highlight |
| `src/lib/motion/` | spring solver, CSS spring tokens, `animate`, attachments, transitions, view transitions |
| `src/lib/theme/` | parametric theme runtime (mode, theme, hue/chroma, radius, density, motion) |
| `src/lib/components/<kit>/<name>/` | the components — see Law 2 |
| `src/lib/components/kits.ts` | the kit list (order, titles) |
| `src/lib/docs/` | `defineDoc`, doc types, GENERATED `api.json` |
| `src/lib/index.ts` | GENERATED barrel |
| `src/routes/` | the docs site — generated pages + hand-written guides |
| `scripts/` | `gen.ts`, `gate.ts`, `verify.ts` and friends |

Generated files carry a `GENERATED` banner — never edit them by hand.

## 4. House rules

- fractalstyler is consumed from `../fractalstyler` (linked). **Never edit
  anything in `../fractalstyler`.** Missing primitives go in the extension layer.
- Do not initialise git, commit, push or publish unless the user asks.
- Work only in the paths you were assigned; other agents are working in
  parallel in sibling folders. Never "fix" a sibling's files — report instead.

## 5. Motion and theme quick reference

Import inside `src/lib` from `'../../../motion/index.js'` / `'../../../theme/index.js'`;
in examples from `'@fractaldesign/maxima-ui/motion'` / `'/theme'` (also re-exported
from the root). Read the sources for the full JSDoc.

```ts
// springs — presets: 'gentle' | 'snappy' | 'bouncy' | 'stiff' | 'slow', or { stiffness, damping, mass }
springs, resolveSpring(input?), springDuration(input?), springEasing(input?), springEase(input?)

// engine — element must carry class "motion" (x y scale rotate opacity) or "tilt" (rotateX rotateY)
animate(node, { x, y, scale, rotate, opacity, rotateX, rotateY, '--custom': n }, { spring, instant, onUpdate }) → { finished, stop() }
setMotion(node, values)   getMotion(node, channel)
new SpringValue(initial, spring?)  → .current (reactive) .target .set(v, { instant })
reducedMotion.current

// attachments — {@attach name(options)}
vars({ value: 0.4 })                    // writes --value (any custom properties)
press() hover() magnetic() tilt()       // interaction springs
pointer()                               // writes --px/--py for spotlights
inView({ class: 'in' }) reveal() stagger()   // entrance; stagger writes --i on children
drag({ axis, bounds, snapBack, momentum, onDragEnd })
parallax() scrollProgress()
createFlip() → { attach, read(), play(), run(fn) }   // FLIP layout springs; items carry data-flip-id

// Svelte transitions with spring easing — transition:springScale={{ spring: 'bouncy' }}
springFade springFly springScale springBlur springSlide

// view transitions
startViewTransition(update, { type: 'fade'|'slide'|'slide-back'|'scale'|'reveal'|'none', origin })
setupViewTransitions(onNavigate, { type })    vtName('hero')   // element also needs class "vt-name"

// theme
theme (ThemeState: mode theme hue chroma tint radius density motion resolvedMode; setTheme() setMode() toggleMode(event) reset())
themes, initTheme(), themeInitScript()
```

CSS side (see `src/lib/styles/layers/10-motion.css`): `.spring` + `.spring-<preset>`
for state transitions, `.pop` + `.enter-*` for anything that opens (works on
`[popover]`, `<dialog open>`, and `.open`), `.anim-in` (staggered by `--i`),
`.reveal`/`.in`, `.lift`, `.press`.
# DESIGN

The design language of maxima-ui. It is fractalstyler's language, held to a
premium bar — restrained, precise, quiet until touched.

## Principles

1. **Composition over invention.** A component is a sentence written in
   fractalstyler's vocabulary. If two components look related, it is because
   they share classes, not because someone matched them by eye.
2. **Hierarchy through ink, not size.** `text-primary` → `text-secondary` →
   `text-muted` carry most hierarchy. Size and weight change rarely.
3. **Hairlines and light.** Surfaces are separated by 1px borders
   (`border`, `border-subtle`) and lifted by the elevation ladder (`shad-*`)
   with a lit top edge (`rim`). Floating surfaces are `glass`.
4. **Motion is physics.** Anything a person moves or triggers is driven by a
   spring — the same solver produces the CSS `linear()` tokens
   (`--spring-snappy` …) and drives the JavaScript engine, so a CSS transition
   and a dragged element settle the same way. Motion is interruptible, never
   blocks input, and collapses to nothing under reduced motion.
5. **One theme, three numbers.** `--hue`, `--chroma`, `--tint` generate every
   colour role in both modes. Shape (`data-radius`), density (`data-density`)
   and motion (`data-motion`) are independent axes that rewrite ladders, not
   components.

## The shared axes

| Axis | Values | Mechanism |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `variant` | primary · secondary · themed · soft · outline · ghost · link · info · success · warning · danger | a class of the same name |
| `size` | xs · sm · md · lg · xl | `sizeClass[size]` → height + text ladder |
| `shape` | rect · mincurved · modern · curved · round | a class of the same name |
| `tone` | neutral · info · success · warning · danger | status colour roles |

## The extension layer

| Layer | Adds |
|:---|:---|
| `00-tokens` | motion channels (`@property`), spring/motion scale, measure ladder |
| `01-springs` | generated `--spring-*` `linear()` easings |
| `10-motion` | `.motion` `.tilt` `.spring` `.pop` `.enter-*` `.anim-*` `.reveal`, view transitions |
| `20-surface` | `.glass` `.rim` `.glow` `.soft` `.measure-*` and small layout primitives |
| `30-overlay` | `.anchor` `.floating` `.dialog` `.sheet` `.layer` |
| `40-controls` | `.bare` `.item` `.track` `.fill` `.thumb` `.ring` `.indicator` `.caret` |
| `60-themes` | the parametric theme and the radius / density / motion axes |
| `kits/*` | ≤ 90 lines per kit, for primitives composition cannot express |

/**
 * The shared prop axes. Every component that takes a variant, a size, a shape
 * or a tone takes THESE — the value is (or maps to) a fractalstyler class, so
 * the same word means the same thing on a button, an input, a card or a tag.
 */

/** Visual style — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Variant =
	| 'primary'
	| 'secondary'
	| 'themed'
	| 'outline'
	| 'ghost'
	| 'link'
	| 'soft'
	| 'info'
	| 'success'
	| 'warning'
	| 'danger';

/** Control scale: height + text size. */
export type Size = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

/** Corner shape — each value is a class of the same name. */
export type Shape = 'rect' | 'mincurved' | 'modern' | 'curved' | 'round';

/** Status colour for messages, badges, meters. */
export type Tone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';

/** Where a floating element sits relative to its anchor. */
export type Placement =
	| 'top'
	| 'top-start'
	| 'top-end'
	| 'bottom'
	| 'bottom-start'
	| 'bottom-end'
	| 'left'
	| 'right';

export type Orientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

/** Height + text classes for a control (button, input, select, toggle). */
export const sizeClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'h-md text-xs',
	sm: 'h-bs text-sm',
	md: 'h-lg text-md',
	lg: 'h-xl text-bs',
	xl: 'h-2xl text-lg'
};

/** Height only — for square things (icon buttons, avatars, dots). */
export const heightClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'h-md',
	sm: 'h-bs',
	md: 'h-lg',
	lg: 'h-xl',
	xl: 'h-2xl'
};

/** Text scale only. */
export const textClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'text-xs',
	sm: 'text-sm',
	md: 'text-md',
	lg: 'text-bs',
	xl: 'text-lg'
};

/** Padding for a surface (card, popover, dialog) at each size. */
export const padClass: Record<Size, string> = {
	xs: 'pad-sm',
	sm: 'pad-md',
	md: 'pad-bs',
	lg: 'pad-lg',
	xl: 'pad-xl'
};

/** `.floating` placement modifier for a Placement. */
export const placementClass: Record<Placement, string> = {
	top: 'at-top',
	'top-start': 'at-top-start',
	'top-end': 'at-top-end',
	bottom: 'at-bottom',
	'bottom-start': 'at-bottom-start',
	'bottom-end': 'at-bottom-end',
	left: 'at-left',
	right: 'at-right'
};

/** Text colour class for a tone. */
export const toneText: Record<Tone, string> = {
	neutral: 'text-secondary',
	info: 'text-info',
	success: 'text-success',
	warning: 'text-warning',
	danger: 'text-danger'
};
import type { Attachment } from 'svelte/attachments';
import type { Orientation } from './tokens.js';

export interface RovingOptions {
	/** Which descendants are items. */
	selector?: string;
	/** Which arrow keys move. `both` accepts all four. */
	orientation?: Orientation | 'both';
	/** Wrap from the last item to the first. */
	loop?: boolean;
	/** Jump to the item whose text starts with what is typed. */
	typeahead?: boolean;
	/** Manage `tabindex` so the group is one tab stop (roving tabindex). */
	tabindex?: boolean;
	/** Called when keyboard navigation lands on an item. */
	onNavigate?: (item: HTMLElement, index: number) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_SELECTOR =
	'[role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"], [role="menuitemradio"], [role="option"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="treeitem"], [data-roving]';

const enabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
	!el.hasAttribute('disabled') && el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true' && !el.hidden;

/**
 * Keyboard navigation for a group of items: arrow keys, Home/End, optional
 * looping and typeahead, with a roving tabindex. Put it on the container.
 */
export function roving(options: RovingOptions = {}): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		const {
			selector = DEFAULT_SELECTOR,
			orientation = 'vertical',
			loop = true,
			typeahead = false,
			tabindex = true,
			onNavigate
		} = options;

		const items = () => Array.from(node.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector)).filter(enabled);
		let buffer = '';
		let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

		const sync = (active?: HTMLElement) => {
			if (!tabindex) return;
			const all = items();
			const current =
				active ??
				all.find((el) => el.tabIndex === 0) ??
				all.find(
					(el) =>
						el.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' || el.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'
				) ??
				all[0];
			for (const el of all) el.tabIndex = el === current ? 0 : -1;
		};

		const go = (all: HTMLElement[], index: number) => {
			const item = all[index];
			if (!item) return;
			sync(item);
			item.focus();
			onNavigate?.(item, index);
		};

		const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
			const all = items();
			if (all.length === 0) return;
			const index = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
			const prevKeys = orientation === 'horizontal' ? ['ArrowLeft'] : orientation === 'vertical' ? ['ArrowUp'] : ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowUp'];
			const nextKeys = orientation === 'horizontal' ? ['ArrowRight'] : orientation === 'vertical' ? ['ArrowDown'] : ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown'];
			let target = -1;

			if (nextKeys.includes(event.key)) target = index + 1 < all.length ? index + 1 : loop ? 0 : index;
			else if (prevKeys.includes(event.key)) target = index > 0 ? index - 1 : loop ? all.length - 1 : Math.max(index, 0);
			else if (event.key === 'Home') target = 0;
			else if (event.key === 'End') target = all.length - 1;
			else if (typeahead && event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey && event.key !== ' ') {
				buffer += event.key.toLowerCase();
				clearTimeout(timer);
				timer = setTimeout(() => (buffer = ''), 500);
				const start = buffer.length === 1 ? index + 1 : Math.max(index, 0);
				const ordered = [...all.slice(start), ...all.slice(0, start)];
				const match = ordered.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer));
				if (match) go(all, all.indexOf(match));
				return;
			} else return;

			event.preventDefault();
			go(all, target);
		};

		const onFocusin = (event: FocusEvent) => {
			const item = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>(selector);
			if (item && node.contains(item)) sync(item);
		};

		sync();
		const observer = new MutationObserver(() => sync());
		observer.observe(node, { childList: true, subtree: true });
		node.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
		node.addEventListener('focusin', onFocusin);
		return () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			observer.disconnect();
			node.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
			node.removeEventListener('focusin', onFocusin);
		};
	};
}

		ch = {
			node,
			prop,
			x,
			v: 0,
			target: x,
			config: resolveSpring(),
			precision: FINE.has(prop) ? 0.0005 : 0.01,
			owner: null

		map.set(prop, ch);
	}
	return ch;
}

function finishRun(run: Run): void {
	if (run.done) return;
	run.done = true;
	run.resolve();
}

function release(ch: Channel): void {
	const owner = ch.owner;
	ch.owner = null;
	if (!owner) return;
	owner.remaining.delete(ch);
	if (owner.remaining.size === 0) finishRun(owner);
}

function snapshot(run: Run): Record<string, number> {
	const out: Record<string, number> = {};
	for (const [key, ch] of run.channels) out[key] = ch.x;
	return out;
}

function tick(dt: number): boolean {
	const writes = new Map<MotionNode, Channel[]>();
	const touched = new Set<Run>();
	const settled: Channel[] = [];

	for (const ch of active) {
		integrate(ch, ch.target, ch.config, dt);
		if (Math.abs(ch.x - ch.target) < ch.precision && Math.abs(ch.v) < ch.precision * 10) {
			ch.x = ch.target;
			ch.v = 0;
			settled.push(ch);

		let list = writes.get(ch.node);
		if (!list) {
			list = [];
			writes.set(ch.node, list);

		if (ch.owner) touched.add(ch.owner);
	}
	// … then write, batched per node (writes only — never a layout read).
	for (const [node, list] of writes) {
		for (const ch of list) node.style.setProperty(ch.prop, format(ch.x));
	}
	for (const run of touched) run.onUpdate?.(snapshot(run));
	for (const ch of settled) {
		active.delete(ch);
		release(ch);

/**

 * `WeakMap`, so a new call continues from the current value *and* velocity —

 * @param options Spring, initial velocities, `instant`, `onUpdate`.

export function animate(node: MotionNode, to: MotionValues, options: AnimateOptions = {}): AnimationHandle {
	let resolve: () => void = () => {};
	const finished = new Promise<void>((r) => (resolve = r));
	const run: Run = { channels: new Map(), remaining: new Set(), onUpdate: options.onUpdate, resolve, done: false };
	const handle: AnimationHandle = {
		finished,
		stop() {
			for (const ch of Array.from(run.remaining)) {
				ch.v = 0;
				ch.target = ch.x;
				active.delete(ch);
				release(ch);
			}
			finishRun(run);
		}
	};

	if (options.instant || reducedMotion.current) {
		setMotion(node, to);
		const values: Record<string, number> = {};
		for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(to)) {
			if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && toProp(key)) values[key] = value;
		}
		options.onUpdate?.(values);
		finishRun(run);
		return handle;
	}

	const config = resolveSpring(options.spring);
	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(to)) {
		const prop = toProp(key);
		if (!prop || typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
		const ch = channelOf(node, prop);
		if (ch.owner && ch.owner !== run) release(ch);
		const v = options.velocity?.[key] ?? options.velocity?.[prop];
		if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)) ch.v = v;
		ch.target = value;
		ch.config = config;
		run.channels.set(key, ch);
		if (ch.x === value && ch.v === 0) {
			// Already exactly there: nothing to schedule, nothing to write.
			active.delete(ch);
			continue;
		}
		// Even a near-target channel goes through the loop, so DOM writes only happen inside the frame.
		ch.owner = run;
		run.remaining.add(ch);
		active.add(ch);
	}

	if (run.remaining.size === 0) {
		finishRun(run);
	} else if (!ticking) {
		ticking = true;
		addTicker(tick);
	}
	return handle;
}

/**
 * Read the current sprung value of a channel on a node. Returns the channel's
 * rest value (`1` for `scale`/`opacity`, else `0`) if it has never been set.
 * @param node The element.
 * @param channel A channel name (`x`, `scale`, …), its property (`--mx`), or a `--custom` property.
 */
export function getMotion(node: Element, channel: string): number {
	const prop = toProp(channel);
	if (!prop) return 0;
	const ch = registry.get(node)?.get(prop);
	if (ch) return ch.x;
	if (node instanceof HTMLElement || node instanceof SVGElement) {
		const inline = parseFloat(node.style.getPropertyValue(prop));
		if (Number.isFinite(inline)) return inline;
	}
	return restOf(prop);
}

/**
 * Read the current velocity (units per second) of a channel on a node; `0` when at rest.
 * @param node The element.
 * @param channel A channel name, its property, or a `--custom` property.
 */
export function getVelocity(node: Element, channel: string): number {
	const prop = toProp(channel);
	if (!prop) return 0;
	return registry.get(node)?.get(prop)?.v ?? 0;
}

/**
 * Set channels immediately, with no animation. Resets their velocity and
 * interrupts any spring running on them.
 * @param node The element.
 * @param values Values by channel (`x`, `y`, `scale`, …, `--custom`).
 */
export function setMotion(node: MotionNode, values: MotionValues): void {
	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
		const prop = toProp(key);
		if (!prop || typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
		const ch = channelOf(node, prop);
		ch.x = value;
		ch.target = value;
		ch.v = 0;
		active.delete(ch);
		release(ch);
		node.style.setProperty(prop, format(value));
	}
}

/**
 * Bind CSS custom properties to an element — the sanctioned way to pass
 * dynamic values to the stylesheet. Keys may be given with or without the
 * leading `--`; `null`/`undefined` removes the property. Numbers are written
 * unitless. Called inline in a template it re-runs whenever its arguments change.
 *
 * @example
 * ```svelte
 * <div class="fill" {@attach vars({ value: progress })}></div>
 * ```
 * @param values Custom property values by name.
 */
export function vars(values: Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>): Attachment<HTMLElement> {
	return (node) => {
		const written: string[] = [];
		for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
			const prop = key.startsWith('--') ? key : `--${key}`;
			if (value === null || value === undefined || (typeof value === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(value))) {
				node.style.removeProperty(prop);
				continue;
			}
			node.style.setProperty(prop, typeof value === 'number' ? fmt(value) : value);
			written.push(prop);
		}
		return () => {
			for (const prop of written) node.style.removeProperty(prop);
		};
	};
}

/** The documentation manifest of one component folder. See AGENTS.md, Law 2. */
export interface ComponentDoc {
	/** The primary export, PascalCase — `Button`. */
	name: string;
	/** One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header. */
	summary: string;
	/** One to three paragraphs. A blank line starts a new paragraph; `code` is allowed. */
	description: string;
	/** Every non-primary component export → one line on what it is for. */
	parts?: Record<string, string>;
	/** Short capability bullets. */
	features?: string[];
	/** How the component is accessible — at least one statement. */
	accessibility: string[];
	/** Keyboard interactions, when the component is interactive. */
	keyboard?: { keys: string; action: string }[];
	/** Non-component exports: functions, attachments, classes, stores. */
	api?: { name: string; type: string; description: string }[];
	/** Slugs of related components. */
	related?: string[];
	status?: 'stable' | 'beta';
}

export function defineDoc(doc: ComponentDoc): ComponentDoc {
	return doc;
}

// The gate's rules. Each check returns diagnostics; nothing here throws on bad input.

import ts from 'typescript';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { ComponentAnalysis, KitInfo } from './analysis.ts';
import { parseTs } from './api.ts';
import type { LayerBuild } from './css.ts';
import { extractScripts, markupOf, matchJsBrace, skipQuoted, stringLiterals } from './svelte.ts';
import { PATHS, closest, cssCodeLines, escapeRe, lineAt, listDir, readText, rel, walkFiles } from './util.ts';

export interface Diag {
	rule: string;
	severity: 'error' | 'warning';
	file: string;
	line: number | null;
	message: string;
	fix: string;
}

export const KIT_BUDGET = 90;

// ── the class allowlist ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Allowlist {
	classes: Set<string>;
	stems: string[];
	registryFound: boolean;
}

export function loadAllowlist(layers: LayerBuild): Allowlist {
	const classes = new Set<string>();
	const stems: string[] = [];
	const raw = readText(PATHS.fsRegistry);
	let registryFound = false;
	if (raw) {
		try {
			const rows = JSON.parse(raw) as { class?: string }[];
			registryFound = Array.isArray(rows);
			for (const row of Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []) {
				const name = (row.class ?? '').replace(/^\./, '').trim();
				if (!name) continue;
				if (name.includes('*')) stems.push(name.replace(/\*.*$/, ''));
				else classes.add(name);
			}
		} catch {
			registryFound = false;
		}
	}
	for (const c of layers.harvested) classes.add(c);
	return { classes, stems, registryFound };
}

export function isAllowed(cls: string, allow: Allowlist): boolean {
	return allow.classes.has(cls) || allow.stems.some((s) => cls.startsWith(s)) || /-(mob|desk)$/.test(cls);
}

function unknownClass(cls: string, file: string, line: number, allow: Allowlist): Diag {
	const near = closest(cls, allow.classes, 3);
	return {
		rule: 'class/unknown',
		severity: 'error',
		file,
		line,
		message: `class "${cls}" is not in the fractalstyler registry or the maxima extension layer`,
		fix: near.length
			? `did you mean ${near.map((n) => `"${n}"`).join(', ')}? (registry.md / src/lib/styles/layers)`
			: 'compose from registry.md, or add the smallest general primitive to your kit fragment'
	};
}

// ── class tokens in markup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

const CLASSY = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/;
const COMPARE_BEFORE = /(===|!==|==|!=|\bin|\bcase)\s*$/;
const COMPARE_AFTER = /^\s*(===|!==|==|!=|in\b)/;

/** Class-looking tokens of the string literals inside a JS expression (comparison operands skipped). */
function expressionClassTokens(expr: string): { token: string; offset: number }[] {
	const out: { token: string; offset: number }[] = [];
	for (const lit of stringLiterals(expr)) {
		if (lit.interpolated) continue;
		// comparison operands (`x === 'vertical'`), `case 'x':` labels and `'x' in o` are not class lists
		if (COMPARE_BEFORE.test(expr.slice(0, lit.start)) || COMPARE_AFTER.test(expr.slice(lit.end))) continue;
		let pos = 0;
		for (const tok of lit.value.split(/(\s+)/)) {
			if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok) && CLASSY.test(tok)) out.push({ token: tok, offset: lit.start + 1 + pos });
			pos += tok.length;
		}
	}
	return out;
}

interface ScriptVar {
	init: string;
	offset: number;
}

/** `const x = …` / `let x = …` initialisers of the instance script, by name. */
function scriptVars(src: string): Map<string, ScriptVar> {
	const out = new Map<string, ScriptVar>();
	for (const s of extractScripts(src)) {
		const sf = parseTs(s.content, 'vars.ts');
		const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
			if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(n) && ts.isIdentifier(n.name) && n.initializer) {
				const start = n.initializer.getStart(sf);
				out.set(n.name.text, { init: n.initializer.getText(sf), offset: s.offset + start });
			}
			ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
		};
		visit(sf);
	}
	return out;
}

export function checkSvelteClasses(file: string, src: string, allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const markup = markupOf(src);
	const vars = scriptVars(src);
	const relFile = rel(file);
	const checked = new Set<string>();
	const check = (cls: string, offset: number) => {
		if (!isAllowed(cls, allow)) out.push(unknownClass(cls, relFile, lineAt(src, offset), allow));
	};
	const checkExpr = (expr: string, base: number) => {
		for (const t of expressionClassTokens(expr)) check(t.token, base + t.offset);
		// identifiers that name script variables: check their initialisers too
		for (const m of expr.matchAll(/(?<![\w$.'"`-])([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(?![\w$])/g)) {
			const v = vars.get(m[1]);
			if (!v || checked.has(m[1])) continue;
			checked.add(m[1]);
			for (const t of expressionClassTokens(v.init)) check(t.token, v.offset + t.offset);
		}
	};

	const ATTR = /(?<=[\s])class\s*=\s*/g;
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(ATTR)) {
		const at = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
		const q = markup[at];
		if (q === '"' || q === "'") {
			let i = at + 1;
			let staticText = '';
			while (i < markup.length && markup[i] !== q) {
				if (markup[i] === '{') {
					const close = matchJsBrace(markup, i);
					if (close < 0) break;
					checkExpr(markup.slice(i + 1, close), i + 1);
					staticText += ' '.repeat(close - i + 1);
					i = close + 1;
					continue;
				}
				staticText += markup[i];
				i++;
			}
			let pos = 0;
			for (const tok of staticText.split(/(\s+)/)) {
				if (tok && !/^\s+$/.test(tok)) check(tok, at + 1 + pos);
				pos += tok.length;
			}
		} else if (q === '{') {
			const close = matchJsBrace(markup, at);
			if (close > at) checkExpr(markup.slice(at + 1, close), at + 1);
		}
	}
	for (const m of markup.matchAll(/(?<=[\s])class:([\w-]+)/g)) check(m[1], m.index ?? 0);
	return out;
}

/** String literals of the exported `Record<…, string>` maps in tokens.ts. */
export function checkTokenMaps(allow: Allowlist): Diag[] {
	const src = readText(PATHS.tokensTs);
	if (!src) return [];
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(src, 'tokens.ts');
	for (const st of sf.statements) {
		if (!ts.isVariableStatement(st) || !st.modifiers?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword)) continue;
		for (const d of st.declarationList.declarations) {
			if (!d.type || !/^Record</.test(d.type.getText(sf)) || !d.initializer || !ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(d.initializer)) continue;
			for (const p of d.initializer.properties) {
				if (!ts.isPropertyAssignment(p) || !ts.isStringLiteral(p.initializer)) continue;
				for (const tok of p.initializer.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) {
					if (!isAllowed(tok, allow)) {
						out.push(unknownClass(tok, rel(PATHS.tokensTs), sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(p.getStart(sf)).line + 1, allow));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out;
}

// ── Law 1: no styles, no svg, JS writes only custom properties ──────────────

function startsWithDashes(arg: ts.Expression | undefined): boolean {
	if (!arg) return false;
	if (ts.isStringLiteral(arg) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(arg)) return arg.text.startsWith('--');
	if (ts.isTemplateExpression(arg)) return arg.head.text.startsWith('--');
	return false;
}

function isStyleAccess(n: ts.Expression): boolean {
	return (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n) && n.name.text === 'style') || (ts.isElementAccessExpression(n) && ts.isStringLiteral(n.argumentExpression) && n.argumentExpression.text === 'style');
}

/** AST checks on one script / TS module. */
export function checkScriptAst(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, inMotion: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const sf = parseTs(code, path.basename(file) + '.ts');
	const line = (n: ts.Node) => lineBase + sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart(sf)).line;
	const push = (n: ts.Node, message: string, fix: string) =>
		out.push({ rule: 'style/js-write', severity: 'error', file, line: line(n), message, fix });
	const CP_FIX = "write a custom property — node.style.setProperty('--x', v) or the vars() attachment — and let a class own the real property";

	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isBinaryExpression(n) && n.operatorToken.kind >= ts.SyntaxKind.FirstAssignment && n.operatorToken.kind <= ts.SyntaxKind.LastAssignment) {
			const left = n.left;
			if (isStyleAccess(left)) push(n, 'assigns element.style directly', CP_FIX);
			else if ((ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) || ts.isElementAccessExpression(left)) && isStyleAccess(left.expression)) {
				const prop = ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(left) ? left.name.text : left.argumentExpression.getText(sf);
				push(n, prop === 'cssText' ? 'writes .style.cssText' : `assigns .style.${prop.replace(/['"]/g, '')}`, CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression)) {
			const method = n.expression.name.text;
			const target = n.expression.expression;
			if (method === 'setProperty' && isStyleAccess(target) && !startsWithDashes(n.arguments[0]) && !inMotion) {
				const lit = n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0]));
				push(
					n,
					lit ? `style.setProperty(${n.arguments[0].getText(sf)}) sets a real property` : 'style.setProperty() with a non-literal name (only src/lib/motion may)',
					"name a custom property literally: setProperty('--x', …)"
				);
			}
			if (method === 'setAttribute' && n.arguments[0] && (ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n.arguments[0])) && n.arguments[0].text.toLowerCase() === 'style') {
				push(n, "setAttribute('style', …)", CP_FIX);
			}
			if (method === 'assign' && target.getText(sf) === 'Object' && n.arguments[0] && isStyleAccess(n.arguments[0])) {
				push(n, 'Object.assign(element.style, …)', CP_FIX);
			}
		}
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

// ── imports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const LIB_BARE = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?)$/;
const EXAMPLE_ALLOWED = /^(svelte(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/icons(\/.*)?|@fractaldesign\/maxima-ui(\/motion|\/theme)?)$/;

export function moduleSpecifiers(code: string): { spec: string; line: number }[] {
	const sf = parseTs(code, 'imports.ts');
	const out: { spec: string; line: number }[] = [];
	const add = (lit: ts.Expression | undefined) => {
		if (lit && ts.isStringLiteral(lit)) out.push({ spec: lit.text, line: sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(lit.getStart(sf)).line });
	};
	const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
		if (ts.isImportDeclaration(n) || ts.isExportDeclaration(n)) add(n.moduleSpecifier);
		else if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && n.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword) add(n.arguments[0]);
		else if (ts.isImportTypeNode(n) && ts.isLiteralTypeNode(n.argument)) add(n.argument.literal);
		ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
	};
	visit(sf);
	return out;
}

export function checkImports(code: string, file: string, lineBase: number, isExample: boolean): Diag[] {
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	for (const { spec, line } of moduleSpecifiers(code)) {
		let bad = false;
		let fix = '';
		if (isExample) {
			if (!EXAMPLE_ALLOWED.test(spec)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = "examples import exactly what a consumer writes: '@fractaldesign/maxima-ui' (/motion, /theme), '@fractaldesign/icons*', 'svelte*'";
			}
		} else if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
			const target = path.resolve(path.dirname(path.join(PATHS.root, file)), spec);
			if (!target.startsWith(PATHS.lib + path.sep)) {
				bad = true;
				fix = 'relative imports must stay inside src/lib';
			}
		} else if (!LIB_BARE.test(spec)) {
			bad = true;
			fix = "inside src/lib import relatively (no $lib, no #lib); only 'svelte*' and '@fractaldesign/icons*' are bare";
		}
		if (bad) out.push({ rule: 'import/forbidden', severity: 'error', file, line: lineBase + line, message: `import '${spec}'`, fix });
	}
	return out;
}

// ── per-file Law 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const GLYPHS = /[✓✔✗✘✕✖☰▾▴▸◂▶◀★☆⨯]/;

export function checkFile(full: string, allow: Allowlist | null): Diag[] {
	const file = rel(full);
	const src = readText(full);
	if (src === null) return [];
	const out: Diag[] = [];
	const inMotion = full.startsWith(PATHS.motion + path.sep);
	const isExample = file.split('/').includes('examples');
	try {
		if (full.endsWith('.svelte')) {
			const noComments = src.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			const markup = markupOf(src);
			const styleBlock = noComments.search(/<style[\s>]/);
			if (styleBlock >= 0)
				out.push({ rule: 'style/block', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, styleBlock), message: '<style> block', fix: 'delete it; compose fractalstyler classes in markup' });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\sstyle\s*=/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/inline', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'style="…" attribute', fix: 'use classes; pass dynamic values as custom properties with the vars() attachment' });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\sstyle:([\w-]+)/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/inline', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: `style:${m[1]} directive`, fix: 'use classes; pass dynamic values as custom properties with the vars() attachment' });
			for (const m of noComments.matchAll(/<svg[\s>/]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/inline-svg', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'inline <svg>', fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
			// visible text only: strip tags and expressions
			const text = markup.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ')).replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			const g = text.search(GLYPHS);
			if (g >= 0)
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/glyph', severity: 'warning', file, line: lineAt(src, g), message: `unicode glyph "${text[g]}" used as an icon`, fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
			for (const m of markup.matchAll(/\.style\.(cssText|[a-zA-Z]+)\s*=(?!=)|setAttribute\(\s*['"`]style['"`]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'style/js-write', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: `writes a real style property in markup (${m[0].trim()})`, fix: "write a custom property — setProperty('--x', v) or vars()" });
			for (const s of extractScripts(src)) {
				out.push(...checkScriptAst(s.content, file, s.line, inMotion));
				out.push(...checkImports(s.content, file, s.line, isExample));
			}
			if (allow) out.push(...checkSvelteClasses(full, src, allow));
		} else if (full.endsWith('.ts')) {
			out.push(...checkScriptAst(src, file, 1, inMotion));
			out.push(...checkImports(src, file, 1, isExample));
			const noComments = src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
			for (const m of noComments.matchAll(/<svg[\s>/]/g))
				out.push({ rule: 'icons/inline-svg', severity: 'error', file, line: lineAt(src, m.index ?? 0), message: 'inline <svg> markup in a string', fix: "use <Icon icon={luName} /> from '@fractaldesign/icons'" });
		}
	} catch (err) {
		out.push({ rule: 'analysis/crash', severity: 'error', file, line: null, message: `could not analyse: ${(err as Error).message}`, fix: 'fix the syntax error' });
	}
	return out;
}

 * Each returns `{ delay, duration, easing, css }` where `duration` is the

const REDUCED_MS = 120;

function reduced(delay: number): TransitionConfig {
	return { delay, duration: REDUCED_MS, css: (t) => `opacity: ${t.toFixed(3)}` };
}

function base(params: SpringTransitionParams): { delay: number; duration: number; easing: (t: number) => number } {
	const spring = params.spring ?? 'snappy';
	return { delay: params.delay ?? 0, duration: springDuration(spring), easing: springEase(spring) };

	const opacity = Number.parseFloat(style.opacity);
	return {
		opacity: Number.isFinite(opacity) ? opacity : 1,
		transform: style.transform === 'none' ? '' : style.transform

const n = (v: number): string => (Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000).toString();

## 1. The two laws

### Law 1 — fractalstyler only

Styling is **composition of registered classes in markup**. Nothing else.

- NO `<style>` blocks. NO `style="…"`. NO `style:prop` directives.
- NO raw hex colours, NO pixel literals above 2px, NO literal `border-radius`.
- NO inline `<svg>` and NO unicode glyph icons — icons are
  `import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons'` +
  `import { luCheck } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide'` → `<Icon icon={luCheck} />`.
  (Check a name exists: `grep -c "luName\b" node_modules/@fractaldesign/icons/dist/lucide.d.ts`.)
- Every class must exist in **fractalstyler's registry**
  (`node_modules/@fractaldesign/fractalstyler/registry.md` — read it) or in the
  **maxima extension layer** (`src/lib/styles/layers/*.css` — read them; they
  are short).
- Modifiers are never standalone: `.row.xcenter`, never a bare `.xcenter`.
- There is no `.w-*`, `.pad-x-*`, `.border-top`. Search the registry; never guess.

**Dynamic values travel through custom properties.** JavaScript may write
*only* custom properties — `node.style.setProperty('--x', …)` — and a class
owns the real property (`translate: calc(var(--mx, 0) * 1px) …`). Use the
`vars()` attachment (`src/lib/motion`) to bind values:
`<div class="fill" {@attach vars({ value: 0.4 })}>`. Never assign
`node.style.transform = …` or any real property.

**The extension layer is small on purpose.** Compose first. If the system
genuinely cannot express something, add the *smallest general primitive* to
your kit's fragment `src/lib/styles/layers/kits/<kit>.css`:

- plain CSS, tokens only (`var(--space-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, colour roles),
  `rem`/`em`/`%` — no px above 2, no hex, no `&` nesting;
- named in the system's voice (`.track`, `.thumb`, `.indicator`) — a

- hard budget: **90 lines per kit fragment**. The gate fails above it;
- only edit your own kit's fragment. Never edit `custom.css` (generated) or

# DESIGN

The design language of maxima-ui. It is fractalstyler's language, held to a
premium bar — restrained, precise, quiet until touched.

## Principles

1. **Composition over invention.** A component is a sentence written in
   fractalstyler's vocabulary. If two components look related, it is because
   they share classes, not because someone matched them by eye.
2. **Hierarchy through ink, not size.** `text-primary` → `text-secondary` →
   `text-muted` carry most hierarchy. Size and weight change rarely.
3. **Hairlines and light.** Surfaces are separated by 1px borders
   (`border`, `border-subtle`) and lifted by the elevation ladder (`shad-*`)
   with a lit top edge (`rim`). Floating surfaces are `glass`.
4. **Motion is physics.** Anything a person moves or triggers is driven by a
   spring — the same solver produces the CSS `linear()` tokens
   (`--spring-snappy` …) and drives the JavaScript engine, so a CSS transition
   and a dragged element settle the same way. Motion is interruptible, never
   blocks input, and collapses to nothing under reduced motion.
5. **One theme, three numbers.** `--hue`, `--chroma`, `--tint` generate every
   colour role in both modes. Shape (`data-radius`), density (`data-density`)
   and motion (`data-motion`) are independent axes that rewrite ladders, not
   components.

## The shared axes

| Axis | Values | Mechanism |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `variant` | primary · secondary · themed · soft · outline · ghost · link · info · success · warning · danger | a class of the same name |
| `size` | xs · sm · md · lg · xl | `sizeClass[size]` → height + text ladder |
| `shape` | rect · mincurved · modern · curved · round | a class of the same name |
| `tone` | neutral · info · success · warning · danger | status colour roles |

## The extension layer

| Layer | Adds |
|:---|:---|
| `00-tokens` | motion channels (`@property`), spring/motion scale, measure ladder |
| `01-springs` | generated `--spring-*` `linear()` easings |
| `10-motion` | `.motion` `.tilt` `.spring` `.pop` `.enter-*` `.anim-*` `.reveal`, view transitions |
| `20-surface` | `.glass` `.rim` `.glow` `.soft` `.measure-*` and small layout primitives |
| `30-overlay` | `.anchor` `.floating` `.dialog` `.sheet` `.layer` |
| `40-controls` | `.bare` `.item` `.track` `.fill` `.thumb` `.ring` `.indicator` `.caret` |
| `60-themes` | the parametric theme and the radius / density / motion axes |
| `kits/*` | ≤ 90 lines per kit, for primitives composition cannot express |
=== src/lib/components/actions/button/Button.svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAnchorAttributes, HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { Icon } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import type { IconData } from '@fractaldesign/icons';
	import { luLoaderCircle } from '@fractaldesign/icons/lucide';
	import { press } from '../../../motion/index.js';
	import { sizeClass, type Shape, type Size, type Variant } from '../../../internal/tokens.js';

	interface Props extends HTMLButtonAttributes {
		/** The visual style. `primary` is the page's main action; use one per view. */
		variant?: Variant;
		/** The control height and text scale. */
		size?: Size;
		/** The corner shape. */
		shape?: Shape;
		/** An icon drawn before the label. */
		icon?: IconData;
		/** An icon drawn after the label. */
		iconEnd?: IconData;
		/** Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon and blocks interaction, keeping the button's width. */
		loading?: boolean;
		/** Stretches the button to the full width of its container. */
		block?: boolean;
		/** Renders an `<a>` that looks like a button. Use for navigation. */
		href?: string;
		/** Where to open the link, when `href` is set. */
		target?: HTMLAnchorAttributes['target'];
		/** Springs the button down under the pointer. Turn off for a still button. */
		pressable?: boolean;
		/** The label. */
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		variant = 'primary',
		size = 'md',
		shape = 'modern',
		icon,
		iconEnd,
		loading = false,
		block = false,
		href,
		target,
		pressable = true,
		disabled,
		type = 'button',
		class: klass,
		children,
		...rest
	}: Props = $props();

	const classes = $derived([
		'button no-scaling gap-sm weight-500',
		variant,
		sizeClass[size],
		shape,
		block ? 'wfull' : 'inline-flex',
		pressable && 'motion',
		klass
	]);
	const spring = $derived(pressable ? press() : undefined);
</script>

{#snippet content()}
	{#if loading}
		<Icon icon={luLoaderCircle} class="anim-spin" />
	{:else if icon}
		<Icon {icon} />
	{/if}
	{@render children?.()}
	{#if iconEnd}
		<Icon icon={iconEnd} />
	{/if}
{/snippet}

{#if href && !disabled}
	<a
		class={classes}
		{href}
		{target}
		rel={target === '_blank' ? 'noopener noreferrer' : undefined}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest as HTMLAnchorAttributes}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</a>
{:else}
	<button
		class={classes}
		{type}
		disabled={disabled || loading}
		aria-busy={loading || undefined}
		{@attach spring}
		{...rest}
	>
		{@render content()}
	</button>
{/if}

import { defineDoc } from '../../../docs/define.js';

export default defineDoc({
	name: 'Button',
	summary: 'Triggers an action or navigates, with a spring-loaded press.',
	description: `The button is the library's reference component: eleven variants, five sizes and five shapes, all of them plain fractalstyler classes, so a button always matches the inputs, tags and cards around it.

It renders a native \`<button>\` — or an \`<a>\` when you pass \`href\` — and forwards every attribute and event to it. Pressing it drives a real spring through the motion channel rather than a CSS keyframe, so a quick tap and a long hold both feel right.`,
	features: [
		'Eleven variants, five sizes, five shapes — shared with every other control',
		'Leading and trailing icons from @fractaldesign/icons',
		'Loading state that keeps the layout stable',
		'Renders a link when given href',
		'Interruptible spring press, disabled under reduced motion'
	],
	accessibility: [
		'Renders a native <button> (or <a> with href), so role, focus and activation come from the platform.',
		'While loading, the button is disabled and exposes aria-busy="true".',
		'An icon-only button needs an aria-label; icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.',
		'The focus ring is drawn only for keyboard focus (:focus-visible).'
	],
	keyboard: [
		{ keys: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Activates the button.' },
		{ keys: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus to the next focusable element.' }
	]
});
